REVIEW_TITLE: Wonderful novel marrying fact and fiction seamlessly.
REVIEW:
This is an absorbing and mesmerising novel which kept me hooked from the first page to the last. Moving seamlessly from the 1930's and the period before the abdication and the death of Diana in 1997. Primarily a novel about two women who were not conventional Windsor women.
I adored the depictions of the 1920's fashions and the author has obviously meticulously researched the fashions of that era, being a fashionista myself I absorbed every detail. The story explores the friendship between Mary who was Wallis Simpson's oldest friend and were once so close they called themselves sisters. Wallis is not painted in a very good light at all in the book but neither is her Prince and you get the feeling that they rather deserve one another.
Running alongside is a parallel story of Rachel and Alex who are in the Alma tunnel right behind Princess Diana in the Mercedes and witnessed the aftermath of the accident. This is a fascinating book and one of the best I have read in a long while. A recommended read.
PRODUCT: Another Woman's Husband: From the #1 bestselling author of The Secret Wife a sweeping story of love and betrayal behind the Crown

REVIEW:
I have given this figurine 5 stars because it is superb quality. Not really my cup of tea as it is so scary. It is supposed to be though as it is described as a Dark Master and it really is. I do love the intricate detail of the skeleton and the dragons are truly superb.
This will make a wonderful gift for a person who is interested in all things gothic and the design is fantastic. Not for my mantelpiece or display cabinet but in the right setting or someone's studio this will make a wonderful talking point.
Toscana designs are famous for their attention to detail and that is what makes them unique, this piece is certainly no exception and I have no hesitation in recommending if this is what you are,looking for. A superb piece.
PRODUCT: Design Toscano Master of the Dark Master of the Dark Skeleton Warrior Statue, Multi-colour, 14x32x42 cm

REVIEW_TITLE: Good value men's cardigan in Navy blue.
REVIEW:
This cardigan for men is in a fine rib knit with a middle fronted zip. For the money this represents value for money, good quality and true to size. Measured it against my husbands jumpers which are medium for a well known store and it measures the same.
I have seen superior cardigans to this one but they three times the price and if you want a basic every day cardigan this is as good as you will find for the money.
PRODUCT: FIND Men's Knitted Bomber, Black, Black (Schwarz)

REVIEW:
This is a Ladybird size little hard book book about cats supposedly written by a cat for cat lovers. It is meant to be about cats but really is about humans and tells us that by following the way cats think and act we will become more independent, find inner peace and achieve great mindfulness.
It doesn't take long to read and is packed with common sense tips, and some not quite so easy to achieve. It tells you in this book that if you follow what it tells you each day over seven weeks at the end of it you will achieve "mindfulness". How much is true I really don't know or even if it works. I did enjoy reading it though and this will make a great little Christmas gift too.
PRODUCT: Catfulness: A cat's guide to achieving mindfulness

REVIEW:
I am not a young adult fiction fan. In fact I have never in my my adult life read teen fiction before BUT because this book is by one of my all time favourite authors Cally Taylor I could not resist and boy am I glad I didn't.
This book is a fantastic read because it is so frightenly plausible. From the first page I was drawn into this storyline and I could not put the book down. Mason Finch is sent to the Residential Reform Academy after being expelled from school for the third time. His sister is quite relieved to be free of him for a bit until she is followed home from school by a stranger who claims to have a message from her brother.
Realising Mason is in danger she realises she has to help him. Extremely well written with a taut plot that I soon knew I had to forfeit what I had planned for the day in order to finish this. I wish I could give it ten stars, a fantastic read and I recommend to all adults not just young adults, this is a situation that frighteningly could become all to real. Fantastic.
PRODUCT: The Treatment

REVIEW_TITLE: Creative and fun play from Galt.
REVIEW:
Galt toys have been synonymous with top quality toys for over forty years and I still have some when my children were small and are still in excellent condition today.
These Jungle Wind Ups are fabulous. X we had a wonderful afternoon making the figures and playing on the race track. The clay is very light which was a surprise I expected it to be like fimo or play dough but it is as light as a feather. You need to make the figures using the mounds in the set. This was hilarious as it is absolutely impossible to get the figures to look anything like the figures on the box. Our creations were inventive though!!
We set them up on the racetrack wound them up and two went backwards as we did them back to front!! This just added to the fun and our little ones loved it. I would say this is best suited to 6 to 8 year olds or maybe younger ones with a little adult help. A good fun creative gift that passes a cold afternoon away cheerily for young minds.
PRODUCT: Galt Toys Jungle Wind Ups

REVIEW_TITLE: Keep your friends close and your enemies closer.
REVIEW:
This is an easy read and quite original but not quite the thriller I thought it was going to be. The book opens with Lily/Juliette letting her little brother drown in a dreadful accident in a swimming pool. Fast forward to her boyfriend Nate Goldsmith dumping her and the lengths she will go to to win him back.
Training as cabin crew with the airline where Nate works as pilot so she can be near him and watch him is the first creepy thing she does. It is quite farcical at times not creepy really. Lily changes her name to Juliette so Nate has no idea who she is. Then she is up for a bravery award by the airline which is the last thing she wants, as she doesn't want to draw attention to herself and have her phot plastered over all the in flight magazines in case he reconsiders her. In the end she locks him up in handcuffs and makes him watch endless reruns of videos and read a passage in a book about the consequences of what she perceives as his actions.
I did not see the end coming mind, an easy read and I did quite enjoy it but it is not quite the genre I was expecting.
PRODUCT: The Perfect Girlfriend

REVIEW_TITLE: Fabulous murder mystery set in the 1950's.
REVIEW:
This is the second novel in this cosy crime series set in the Devon Riveria,in then1950"s. Featuring our intrepid Judy Dimont ex secret agent now crime fighter extrodinaire this book kept me entertained and guessing till the end.
I must say I have revised my opinion of Miss Dimont, in my mind after the last book I thought she was a bit of a frump, in this second book she is something of a glamour puss. I loved the nostalgia of the 1950's and whilst the story itself is startlingly good the depictions of life in the 1950's is marvellous. There are red herrings galore here but in the end Judy gets her man or woman! No spoilers from me.
A brilliant new novel and I am delighted that there are several more to come, I cannot wait. Brilliant new series.
PRODUCT: Resort to Murder (A Miss Dimont Mystery, Book 2)

REVIEW_TITLE: A heartwarming and delightfully entertaining tale.
REVIEW:
This is a wonderful book. It is going to be an enormous bestseller. I loved every word and the illustrations are exceptionally brilliant. The book is a hardback which my grandchildren are going to adore. I am afraid though they will have to read it at Grandma's because I am not going to be able to part with it. A beautiful,book to look at and a joy to read. It absorbed me from the first page and the three friends reminded me of the three in Harry Potter.
Archer is a dreamer, his grandparents are too, his parents are not. Archer lives in his grandparents house and his parents do their,level best to keep him grounded but Archer wants to go off exploring and take his friends with him. To say I loved this book is an understatement it a absolute treasure and I adored every page. I cannot wait for book two. Twenty out of ten.
PRODUCT: The Doldrums (The Doldrums, Book 1)

REVIEW:
This is a fabulous shampoo if like me you have blonde hair that is coloured. My hair has been coloured in a salon for years and after a few weeks does tend to go a bit yellows which I absolutely hate. I tried this shampoo with great reservations as the last time I used this sort of shampoo it turned my hair blue!!!
I washed as I would normally, lathers easily and rinses out just as easily. After blow drying my hair was silky, soft and smelt lovely. I have oily hair and with this shampoo I can go an extra day. I use this shampoo and then the next two washes I use my normal shampoo, my hair is subtly different as the blonde seems more defined and I love it.
A great shampoo to be used I think in conjunction with the usual shampoo and conditioner. I recommend and will re-buy.
PRODUCT: L'Oreal Colorista Silver Shampoo, 200 ml

REVIEW:
I have used many of these mousse products over the years in an effort to help my wayward hair. I have had varying degrees of success with some much better and effective than others.
This mousse is an OK product. Before using I expect great things because of the hefty price tag. I love TIGI products but sadly this dipoles not live up to the high standards of their products. Ccthe nozzle is very flimsy and needs a lot of pressure exerted to release the foam. You need to be speedy applying as it evaporates quickly and goes to liquid.
My hair was certainly more bouncy and did hold for a while but a product at half the price would have done the same.
PRODUCT: TIGI Catwalk Strong Hold Mousse, 200 ml

REVIEW_TITLE: Has to be one of the best books I have read this year.
REVIEW:
This is one of the most unputdownable books I have read in a long while. Fast, laugh out loud funny in places and edge of my seat hripping with the most brilliant finish.
This is a stand alone novel featuring Roberta Steel who has been demoted following the planting of evidence in her previous case. She hates her horrible new job, the book opens with her chasing a couple of would be gangsters/thirteen year olds after they had been on a shoplifting spree.
The book soon ratchets up some gears and with no sign of Logan McRae I did wonder how this would pan out, I was absorbed from page one. I do not want to give the plot away but Roberta Steel is my favourite Detective Sergeant and this book gives a great insight into how the police work and play. Ten out of ten. Recommended read.
PRODUCT: Now We Are Dead

REVIEW:
I have given this double sided tape five stars because I have just used it for the first time and it is fantastic. Unlike the ones I usually use this is thin tape which bonds to the wall/surface straight away with an iron like grip and I fixed the housing for the remote control unit to the wall and it grips it securely with no spongy movement in between which you get with the basic double sided tapes I normally use.
Uniquely this tape can be moved if you decide you have put it in the wrong place or just want to move it. Does not peel off the paint behind it, in fact left no trace at all. If you think this is expensive at �9.00 a roll you certainly get what you pay for in this instance, brilliant tape.
PRODUCT: 3M 9088-200 High Performance Double Coated Tape, 25 mm x 50 m, White, Pack of 9

REVIEW:
These little girls shoes are the epitome of cuteness. These are the second pair I have had from RED WAGON and this pair are every bit as good as the first.
This time these are black patent, with the sweetest little butterflies on each shoe. Two on each give these black patent little girls shoes a uniqueness that make them stand out from the normal black school shoes.
Incredibly well made, in a a shiny black patent they are easy to clean and very sturdy but also really stylish with a Velcro strap that secures over the arch of the foot.
No hesitation in recommending as they are everything our little one could want in a shoe and she adores them and they fit her perfectly. A true to size fit also.
PRODUCT: RED WAGON Girls' Back to School Butterfly Trim Mary Jane, Black (Black Patent), 11 UK Child

REVIEW_TITLE: Well presented food and drink extravaganza.
REVIEW:
This is one of the best put together cookery books I have encountered in a while. 220 pages of recipes and cocktails all lavishly depicted in beautiful photographs. The second book by this very talented author. The photographs are eye catching and appealing and make you want to try them all.
My only gripe would be where do you get these weird and wonderful ingredients. Some I have never heard of. The cocktails I think I could improvise on and use alternate ingredients but not so with the recipes. There are a few that I am going to try though, the lamb cutlets look delicious, and even though I am a non meat eater I am going to make these when my friend and her family come as,they are absolute foodies and I know these will impress and they will love,them.
This,will make a great Christmas present too and look impressive as a coffee table book.
PRODUCT: Good Together: Drink & Feast with Mr Lyan & Friends

REVIEW_TITLE: Brilliant gift set with excellent products.
REVIEW:
I have been seriously impressed with the Tigi products I have used. This set is impressive. A full size can of hairspray and a thickening styling cream is included in this large gift set. This will make a superb Christmas gift if you can beat to part with it.
The hairspray is effective, I have soft flyaway very fine hair but loads of it. Most hairsprays that I use are not terribly good and do not hold my hair for long unless I use cheap ones which set my hair like cement. The hairspray in this works really well on my hair. It is the first one I have found that will hold my hair and gives it a shine too and brushes out easily. It has a pleasant smell too.
The cream I applied to my hair after I had towel dried it and it acts as a volumiser and helped style my hair easily when blow drying. This would a great product if putting your hair up or for a spiked style. A brilliant set which I recommend.
PRODUCT: TIGI Bed Head Pump'd and Polished Gift Set

REVIEW_TITLE: Actually does what it is supposed to.
REVIEW:
This is the first time I have used one of thesePomades. I am delighted with the result of this L'OReal one in the blonde shade which is the perfect colour for my brows. I have over plucked brows as I was a seventies chick and as was the trend then over plucked my eyebrows and have struggled ever since.
I have used eyebrow pencils for years with varying degrees of success and this was completely new to me. In two parts this is made up of the eyebrow brush and the powder which has a creamy like substance. The brush is superb taut enough to collect the powder and supple enough to glide over the eyebrows and give a natural made up effect to my brows. Much more professional than a pencil.
The powder is easy to apply to the brush and you need very little to complete two eyebrows so making for excellent value for money as this is a product that will last a long while. Centre melt attractive to look at in a pinky champagne colour and look like a miniature bottle of wine or champagne.
I am very impressed and will binning my eyebrow pencils and am a pomade convert. Ten out of ten.
PRODUCT: L'Oreal Paris Paradise Brow Pomade, Blonde

REVIEW_TITLE: Top quality salon professional Bed Head Gift Set.
REVIEW:
This gift set comprises of three 250 ml size hair products from TIgi. This set contains volume shampoo which I have used before and it produces great results leaving my hair squeaky clean and more body which my hair needs desperately as it is so fine but I have masses of it, Also you have the Conditioning jelly which makes me seem to have even more hair and leaves my hair in tip top condition. The cream on top of this fantastic set is the volumiser which I spray on to my roots before blow drying which makes my hair so much easier to style.
This is a fabulous gift set that would make a wonderful Christmas present if you can bear to give it away. I love all these products and think if bought separately would work out more expensive. This set is the exception to the rule of gift sets where one or the other of the products included you know you will never use. Brilliant buy and no hesitation in recommending.
PRODUCT: TIGI Bed Head Size Matters Gift Set

REVIEW_TITLE: Edgy up to the minute fashion watch by ICE.
REVIEW:
This fashion watch by ICE comes in a khaki plastic case with ice watch on the front and the slogan CHANGE. YOU CAN. On the top of the box.
Depicted as unisex I would say it is very masculine and unless into chunky watches more suited to a male wrist. Attractive to look at with a brown face white dials and white numbers 12, 3, 6 and 9 and the other figures depicts by white dots. The strap is khaki with white stitching and so far has kept completely accurate timing.
I like this watch very much and it is a great buy at �60.00. With Christmas on the horizon this will make a fabulous present.
PRODUCT: Ice-Watch - 014554 - ICE sixty nine - Khaki - Large

REVIEW_TITLE: Salon quality professional hair treatment for blondes.
REVIEW:
I have blonde hair that I have coloured in a salon every six to eight weeks. The salon I go to use a different product to Bed Head and this is the first time I have tried it. I am very very impressed.
My hair is in desperate need of a colour and cut and I am holding out as long as I can as I am on holidays in a couple of weeks so want it fresh to go. I washed and conditioned my hair this morning using the Bed Head dumb blonde shampoo and reconstruct or conditioner.
The shampoo is superb, my hair felt super soft and very smooth. It also seems a little thicker, I have very fine hair but loads of it making it hard to style. The conditioner seemed to work magic too, for once no knots to comb out with my tangle tease and this conditioner seems to have lifted the texture of my hair and made for easy styling. For once I am happy with my hair after washing and blowdrying myself. Chappa to recommend this product and will certainly be using regularly and re-buying.
PRODUCT: TIGI Bed Head Blonde Therapy Gift Set

REVIEW:
This book has a fabulous cover, is wonderfully illustrated but the story is weak and I am not sure about the text. Love the size of the book also. If the story was plausible I think it would be worthy of five stars. The children are lovely in the story but the moral is wrong, if you want something pay for it rather than steal it or in this case cat nap.
I would look at other books by these authors if they decide to write any more if only for the wonderful illustrations.Worthy of three stars for the presentation.
PRODUCT: The SACCONEJOLYs and the Great Cat-Nap

REVIEW:
This book is a page turner that I found very hard to put down. Clever and absorbing with overtures of Gilian Flynn's Gone Girl.
Dr Anna Fox is a psychologist and after a really traumatic experience herself ends up with mental health illnesses, agoraphobia amongst them. As her marriage disintegrates and her husband and her decide to separate Olivia, their,daughter moves in with her dad.
Anna goes from bad to worse, self medicating on too much red wine, and over medicating on her prescriptions. She begins spying on her neighbours and watching old movies until the early hours of the morning.
Then new neighbours move in across the road. Anna never or very seldom has any visitors but the new neighbour pays a visit. Ann is immediately unnerved and senses something strange about her. This book is full of so many twist and turns and red herrings and build up to an electrifying conclusion. One of the best thrillers I have read in a long while.
PRODUCT: The Woman in the Window

REVIEW:
A cheerful little snowman with a light up tummy which changes colour every ten seconds or so, after you put three batteries in of course!!
His tummy is white plastic with two cotton wool type bobbles for buttons on the front, his legs are soft fabric but one is raised in the air a little as if he is a bit tipsy! A striped scarf matches his cuffs on his gloves and ankles. He is wearing a red check little bobble hat with a red bobble on top.
A novelty little man that will cheer up the grey winter weather - if we have any, otherwise he is a fun item to add to the Christmas festivities.
PRODUCT: WeRChristmas Pre-Lit Novelty Sitting Snowman with LED Light-Up Body and Legs Christmas Decoration - 19 cm, Multi-Colour

REVIEW_TITLE: Brings a smile to everyone's face.
REVIEW:
This is a cute little Santa that sings Jimgle Bell rocks when you press play on his right hand. After you put in three batteries of course!! Well made and very seasonal this is a novelty Santa that sits on any surface with a ledge for his legs to dangle over.
He is cheerful and all the WeR Christmas products I have seem to be extremely good quality and value for money. I love this little man with his long legs and smiley face. His hat is edged with green and red and his his pointy white beard matches his white legs. A great decoration for Christmas.
PRODUCT: WeRChristmas Musical Waving Santa Christmas Decoration, 24 cm - Multi-Colour

REVIEW:
These storage containers are in a range of three colours. Lime green, pink and blue. Sturdy with lids they are dishwasher and freezer friendly and of the same quality as Tupperware which makes them pretty good and will stand the test of time.
I have taken one star off as they are much smaller than they are portrayed in the picture. Only suitable for mini tomatoes or grapes or toddler snacks. A really good set of obtained but they are very small.
PRODUCT: Sistema Lunch Food Storage Container with Contrasting Clips, Green/Pink/ Blue, 400 ml, Pack of 3

REVIEW_TITLE: Effective shampoo and conditioner for dogs.
REVIEW:
This is yet another really effective shampoo and conditioner for dogs. I have several of these shampoos and dog wipes and have come to the conclusion they are some of the best on the market for the price.
I have two cockapoos that love rolling in fox poo, bird poo, dead fish and anything else is I take my eyes off them when we are out for their walks. These shampoos are effective, wash their coats thoroughly and the shampoo rinses out easily. My one cockapoo has very thick poodle fur and if not brushed and combed daily the knots are impossible to get out.
This shampoo does the job and the conditioner is amazing for keeping his coat knot free. My personal opinion is this a brilliant value for money shampoo and conditioner for dogs that is very cost effective as you only need a small amount (the size of a fifty pence piece) to wash and condition and average size dog. Very happy with this brand.
PRODUCT: Animology Dog Shampoo and Conditioner, 250ml, Pack of 2

REVIEW_TITLE: Great little bulbs at a very competitive price.
REVIEW:
I have used LED bulbs for a long time and the saving on electricity is noticeable. These bulbs are a lot cheaper than I paid for them originally, almost a third I think. Theses bulbs are bright, easy to fit and dimmable.
They give a bright light and I am so pleased with them. I had two old bulbs in the utility room that I had not got around to changing and these did the trick, the light is so much brighter, they will be cost effective and should last for a,very long time.
I have used a lot of Amazon basic products and there is nothing basic about them, they are top quality products at a basic cost. Very pleased.
PRODUCT: AmazonBasics LED E14 Small Edison Screw R50 Reflector Bulb, 3.5W (equivalent to 40W), Warm White, Dimmable- Pack of 2

REVIEW:
I have accumulated a lot of Animology cleaning products for my two cockapoos and they are all fantastic and deliver what they promise. However I have been mega impressed with the Fox Poo shampoo. In Cornwall earlier this month during a walk my youngest dog rolled in fox poo before I could stop him. The smell is absolutely horrible, much much worse than bird poo, all I had was baby wipes which wiped the mess off but left the smell. We bathed him with his normal doggy shampoo when we got back and the smell was still there, in total he had one bath and two showers and we could still smell it. It lasts for days!!
Taking him through the fields this week he did exactly the same again, fox poo is like a magnet to him. I put him in the shower and washed him with the fox poo shampoo and. After one wash and one rinse GONE, absolutely no trace of the revolting smell at all. Really really recommend.
The clean sheets are great, I have used them before in the large pack and find them indispensable, especially when they have mucky paws at this time of the year.
The stink bomb deodorant will be very very handy at certain times of the day when their smell threatens to overpower you. The dirty dawg shampoo is effective with a pleasant scent. At just over thirteen pounds this set is a brilliant buy and would make a great gift too.
PRODUCT: Animology Essential Dog Cleaning Kit

REVIEW:
When I first saw these I thought just by looking at them that they were expensive for what I thought they were. A box of 10 pencils!! How wrong can you be, they are a pencil, crayon and water colour all in one. Suitable for little ones but absolutely invaluable for art students or people like me who just love to doodle when they should be doing other things! Easy to grip for small fingers and much more durable than ordinary crayons that tend to snap as soon as pressure is applied.
My friend's little one has spent the last two hours completely absorbed with these and the colours are really dense and best of all they wash out of clothing.
I have just completed,a picture using these as a water colour and they are seriously impressive, I love the colours and have no hesitation in recommending and. I shall be re-buying for Christmas presents for my own grandchildren as they are lovely.
PRODUCT: STABILO Woody 3-in-1 Multi-Purpose Pencil with Sharpener and Stencil - Assorted colours (Pack of 10)

REVIEW:
These are top quality LED small screw candle light bulbs that emit a lovely bright light and have th bonus of being dimmable. I have trialled these two in my chandelier ( which takes 8 of these candle bulbs ) and I am so impressed I have pre-ordered a pack of six to replace the ordinary candle bulbs that are in situ at the moment.
They profess to give 15,000 hours of light which is seriously impressive. The quality of light is bright and clear and I have had so much from Amazon's basic range in the past and they have all been top quality so am happy to recommend, really pleased with these bulbs that a competitively priced and well packaged.
PRODUCT: AmazonBasics LED E14 Small Edison Screw Candle Bulb, 6W (equivalent to 40W), Clear, Dimmable- Pack of 2

REVIEW:
My mum used Nivea, I use Nivea and now my daughter uses Nivea. These are gorgeous products in a lovely heart shaped gold tin which can be used again to keep all those irritating bits and bobs that you don't have a home for.
Nivea products are tried and tested and have stood the test of time. The products are good quality and excellent value for money and actually do what they,are supposed,to. This gift tin contains three full sized products, a shower cream, a body lotion and a lip balm all in rose fragrance. The scent is floral without being sticky or cloying and I am impressed with it. This is one of the few gift sets that is actually excellent value for money with all three products eminently useable. I will be purchasing a couple of these for Christmas gifts. Absolutely recommend.
PRODUCT: Nivea Perfect Skin Gift Pack

REVIEW:
An intriguing look,at a small town and the paranoia that can grip a community when little incidents turn into major dramas.
Living in a struggling small rural town in Australia which is full of little secrets and big lies Rose Blakely is desperate to become a journalist and is hoping to escape by obtaining a journalist's cadets hip in the city. So far she has absolutely no luck at all. When strange events begin to happen in her small town Rose decides to take matters into her own hands and begins writing for a local paper and making her own news story. What she has no conception of is the enormous trouble and absolute fear this is stirring up and later the awful repercussions this has for the town.
I really enjoyed this novel as much as the first by this author. The characters here are mostly very unlikeable but totally believable. Rose is about the best but as hope to be journalist makes some unwise decisions that she later bitterly regrets. A really good read that I very much enjoyed.
PRODUCT: Little Secrets

REVIEW:
These little girl's shoes are adorable. Incredibly well made in the softest leather with a gorgeous red Daisy acting as a buckle. The edges on the inside of the shoe are scalloped and soles are rubber as in the children's sandals from Clark's and Startrite.
Our little one is in size 10 at the moment and she adores these and they are just a little too big but will be ready for the Christmas parties to wear with her party outfits. I have seldom seen such a pretty pair of shoes that are so well made and come in a lovely box wrapped in tissue.
I would definitely go back to this brand again even though this is the first time I have heard of them, if I could give ten stars I would. A fantastic range for children.
PRODUCT: RED WAGON Girls' Pop Flower Mary Jane, Yellow, 11 UK Child

REVIEW:
What book! Well it more like an ecyclopedia of Bollywood. If it not in the pages of this book then it is not worth knowing. This is a veritable feat of knowledge, photographs and the glamour that is Bollywood.
I have long been curious as to the machinations of Bollywood in comparison to Hollywood where I have visited several times. This book dispels the myths and through its pages it came to life for me. Packed with fabulous film stills, behind the scene stories and gossip, profiles of the biggest stars. The costumes are magnificent, glittering over the top and utterly fabulous. Some of the films I had never heard of but they are all undeniably Bollywood epics and iconic in India.
This is a book I will treasure, I knew it would be factually informative and descriptive as it is a Dorling Kingsley, From 1913 to the present day everything is covered, nothing at all is left out, you will never need another book on Bollywood, I did think this would make a lovely present for my Granddaughter but I cannot bear to part with it.
PRODUCT: Bollywood: The Films! The Songs! The Stars! (Definitive Visual Guide)

REVIEW:
This shampoo is salon quality and it shows. I have fine fly away hair but masses of it and it is really difficult to keep any sort of order to it. I have used salon products for years in the hope it will help my hair.m this shampoo is lovely, left my hair really soft and silky and with a gorgeous smell which was still discernible after I had blow dried it.
Part of the CATWALK range, this one spiciest it is for curls, well my hair will never be curly unless I have a curly perm! Definitely more volume to it though after blow drying and a little goes a long way which makes it cost effective. I will definitely re-buy and am going to invest in the conditioner that matches this shampoo. Recommended purchase.
PRODUCT: TIGI Catwalk Curls Rock Shampoo, 750 ml

REVIEW_TITLE: Top notch nail polish from essie..
REVIEW:
Since discovering this brand of nail polish it has fast become my favourite. The range of colours is fantastic and this As If is a lovely blue/lilac shade. It goes on really well, is quick drying and whilst not unchippable it does last slightly better than the other brands I used to use.
The brush is quite wide and the polish goes on easily, looks great on my toe nails too. It does not dry my nails out as the bel polish tends to and I am really happy to recommend and I cannot wait to try out the new winter colours in this lovely range of nail polishes.
PRODUCT: essie Original Nail Polish, 13.5ml, 501 As If

REVIEW_TITLE: Salon standard styling set from BaByliss.
REVIEW:
This set from BaByliss is part of their boutique range and comprises:-
Salon Soft Waves Professional Wand.
Salon Power Blow Dryer hairdryer.
These two items are beautifully presented in two separate pink boxes with a model on the front of each showcasing her hair.
The salon soft waves professional wand is stylish and suitable for longer hair to style in curls. The barrel is wide so makes for ease of curling. I particularly love the heat resistant storage pouch which protects the ceramic heat surface after styling.
The salon power blow dry hairdryer is a revelation. I do not say that lightly. I have for years only ever used salon standard hair dryers and my last one was at least twice the price of this one and is now just about coming to the end of its life. This is a smallish dryer and as such I was afraid it would not be powerful enough for me. How wrong could I be? This dryer has a very powerful 2400.watt motor which makes blow drying a quick and easy process. It is light to hold which makes it easy to use. Ther are three heat settings and two speed settings (low and high). If you feel it is getting too hot for comfort there is a finger switch to turn off the heat and direct a blast of cold air instead, a feature I have used many times. The nozzle is streamlined and slim but dries the hair as quickly as a dryer with a longer nozzle.
Easy to use, easy to store and easy on the purse, as this is a top of the range set at a top of the budget end price range, this would make a superb gift and I absolutely recommend.
PRODUCT: BaByliss Boutique Salon Power Hair Dryer and Soft Waves Wand Collection

REVIEW_TITLE: Fantastic products for long hair dogs.
REVIEW:
I have used a lot of Animology dog products and the wipes for cats and they have all been excellent. This however takes dog shampoo up a notch for me. I have two cockapoos and the one is easy to groom and my other is a nightmare. His fur is so thick because of the poodle fur underneath his coat he matts and is miserable when I am giving his daily comb out. If I don't do him every day it becomes impossible and when he goes to the groomer she wants to shave it all off. This shampoo is amazing, after bathing him I dried his fur with the hairdryer and brushed him this time not used the dreaded comb, used the knot sure de-tangled and I cannot believe how easy it is to groom him after using these products.
I wish I had known of them before and the end result is a happy poo and an even happier owner, I absolutely highly recommend these products and will definitely rebut, if I could give ten stars. I would.
PRODUCT: Animology Dog Detangle Kit, 250ml, Pack of 2

REVIEW_TITLE: Best creamy exfoliate I have used.
REVIEW:
Havin suffered with oily skin all my life and I am a big fan of the right exfoliations, and have tried many some with good results and some not so good. This exfoliation from proactive has to be the best I have ever used.
I have used now for three days and the difference in my skin is immense, the greasiness on my t zone has receded to almost no oiliness at all and my skin is so smooth and soft.
I applied to my skin after dampening and massaged for 3 minutes, rinsed off with tepid water, patted dry and then applied my normal moisturiser, but I have the proactive one also and am going to use that in conjunction with this exfoliation.
Proactiv have introduced this as part of their three step treatment programme and I have step one and step three, so I am going to invest in the pore treatment which is step two as I think using all three will achieve even greater skin benefits for me. Also this is cost effective as you only need a small amount to exfoliate the whole of the face so a little will go a long way. Happy to recommend as I am delighted with this.
PRODUCT: Proactiv Skin Smoothing Exfoliator

REVIEW_TITLE: Pretty good as a stand alone moisturiser.
REVIEW:
Whilst the information included in this product is at best confusing and at worst really misleading, the Hydrator itself really is a pretty good product. Whilst I agree it is misleading to say use after steps one and two, I have taken this with a pinch of salt as whilst I am sure it would be beneficial to use this as part of a three step beauty regime, I have had positive results using this as a stand alone moisturiser.
This Hydrator has left my skin silky smooth and seems to have toned down my red patches, works as a gentle moisturiser and left my skin feeling soft and silky smooth. I would take the blurb about steps one and two with a pinch of salt and if you just want a really good Hydrator/moisturiser,at a reasonable price you can't go wrong with this.
PRODUCT: Proactiv Complexion Perfecting Hydrator

REVIEW:
This is a brilliant card game based on Top Trumps but is a card game for WWE fans. There are five hundred questions split into four categories and is an entertaining easy to play game with few rules. My family are avid game players and this is something they have not come across before and they loved it. My grandson is eight and he has played the game a few times and loves it.
The packing case is smart and it will pass the time away on long car journeys for them. At under �10.00 this is a really good buy and is a game that all the family can participate in and with Christmas coming will make a great stocking filler.
PRODUCT: WWE Top Trumps Quiz Game

REVIEW:
I like this shampoo. I have two cockapoos and have used a lot of Animology products on them so was happy to try this shampoo. My one cockapoo is always rubbing in undesirable smelly things when we go for a walk so has to have a bath quite frequently. I usually use a very expensive organic doggy shampoo but this time tried this one.
I found it very gentle on their skin, makes a lovely lather not too much though and it rinsed off easily. The smell is lovely and lingers for a while,so they smell nice for a short while afterwards. More importantly they were not knotted or had any tangles in their fur and were so easy to brush and comb through afterwards. Neither dog seemed itchy and there was no scratching. I am happy to recommend this as it is a really good dog shampoo which is a tad expensive but to me worth it.
PRODUCT: Animology True Colour Enhancing Dog Shampoo, 250 ml

REVIEW:
I already use these wipes for the dogs ( in the doggy version ) So I know they are practical and useful. They are smooth on the one side and rougher on the other. They have a pleasant scent that is not overpowering and they work well.
I envisage that a 20 pack of these wipes will last a long time as it is not very often that cats need wiping as they are self groomers. Our family cat does occasionally have something stuck in his fur and if he has been out in the bad weather he needs his paws wiping. They work well and do not break in use leaving bits in his fur as other cheaper wipes have done.
I have taken one star off as they are smaller than expected, other than that a useful product to have on standby for cat clean ups.
PRODUCT: Animology Feline Fresh Cat Wipes (20)

REVIEW_TITLE: My favourite range of nail polishes.
REVIEW:
These gel nail varnishes come in a range of various colours and this is my fourth one to date. The colour is pale possibly a bit paler than how I remember the colour of my ballet shoes to be. Nevertheless it looks lovely on after a top coat is applied to give it a bit more depth.
The brush is excellent nice and wide and gives good coverage of the polish when you apply to the nail. The twisty bottle is quirky and makes it easy to grip. I love the gel nail varnish because it will last on my nails for five days or more without chipping, whereas ordinary nail varnish usually chips,with me the same day as I apply. Really do recommend the range of,these polishes but not perhaps the colour.
PRODUCT: essie Gel Couture Nail Polish, Ballet Nudes Collection 2017, 445 At The Barre 13.5 ml

REVIEW:
This concealer comes in a small compact with a mirro and includes a small applicator brush which has nowhere to live. There are four shades of concealer in the compact and I blended two to get the shade I wanted for my skin tone.
I found the concealer excellent on two fronts, firstly I have developed a breakout of spots on my chin due to burning the candle,at both ends, I mixed a colour with the concealer and applied to the breakout. My first impression was wow this really has done a great job in hiding the spots. I was more pleased that the concealer is actually helping to heal my face too.
The other point of use was just by my eye where I have two age spots, they don't bother me a great deal but I applied the concealer and again absolutely delighted that the concealer,did its job in effectively making the age spots disappear. On cleaning I am delighted to say my spots,look less,angry and have started to recede. I absolutely recommend this product despite,the price. Ci think it is a,case of getting what you pay for here.
PRODUCT: Proactiv Instant Fix Concealer

REVIEW:
I am happy to say this has not been tested on animals and so it is a yes from me from the off. I asked my friend to try this as he has a beard and is very particular about it. Suffering from a little discomfort with itchy skin underneath his beard he was more than happy to give this a try.
He absolutely loved the scent of cedar wood-so did I! After massaging a few drops into his beard he then combed it through and massaged into the skin as well.
His comments were his beard was easier to tame after using this, he smelt fresh, his itch skin is much improved and the scent is amazing. In short he loved it so much he is going to buy another immediately. L'OReal are a tried and trusted brand and this is a really good product for men's grooming and I am happy to recommend.
PRODUCT: L'Oreal Men Expert Barber Club Long Beard & Skin Oil, 30ml

REVIEW:
There are a lot of gift packs around this time of the year, some,good some not,so good What makes this set stand out is the quality of the presentation. These Simple products apart from being fabulous products in their own right they are housed in a lovely basket which will make a useful addition to any bathroom after the products are used.
Really good value for money this gift set will make a beautiful present for someone special at Christmas. I love the Simple wipes and I have used them for years. The flannel is lovely and soft and the light moisturiser is great for daytime use for normal skin. I am not usually a fan of the water but have sampled this one and love it! Without a doubt one of the best gift sets out there so far this year. Absolutely recommend.
PRODUCT: Simple Hydration Gift Set

REVIEW:
This is a mineral finishing powder that really is effective at minimising the oil on my skin. I have a greasy T zone and this does cause me a problem by mid morning. I used this and it really does work and also is a great finishing powder that sets my foundation too.
The pot is very small with a large lid and there is no applicator included. A normal power brush is far too big so I used a cosmetic sponge the first time, straight from the pot. This morning I put the powder on the bag of my hand and transferred to my face with the brush, this is a bit finicky but I feel achieved by far the best result.
Whilst I am delighted with the results this is expensive for a finishing powder as there is only a small amount in the pot and will not last very long. Would use again though as it really is very good.
PRODUCT: L'Oreal Paris True Match Minerals Finishing Powder

REVIEW:
I have read all Hilary Boyd's previous books and. I have enjoyed them all. This one is by far the best she has written and really is unputdownable. I resented the time I was unable to continue reading this and then was devastated to realise I had finished it and even re-read the last chapter.
The book focuses on additictions and has been incredibly well researched. It shows how in the grip of additictions nothing else matters only feeding the addiction. Freddy is married to Lily and they are two completely different people but they love each other passionately. Fr eddy is Lily's second husband who she met after the death of her first husband.
Freddie is an addict gambler who owes hundreds of thousands of pounds and has no way of clearing any of it. His only hope is to have a big win, in debt to Chinese loan sharks he goes to Las Vegas in a last ditch attempt to seek investment for his once successful recording studio. Lily is clueless at first to what is going on but she knows that Freddy is hiding something.
There really is only one winner when you gamble and that is certainly not the gambler as this book clearly illustrates. So very well researched and a fantastic story. Worthy of ten stars, I cannot wait for the next one.
PRODUCT: A Perfect Husband

REVIEW_TITLE: Seriously good book on Cantonese food.
REVIEW:
This has to be one of the best recipe books I have ever seen, I am so impressed. From the front cover to the back page this is a seriously impressive book. A absolute must for foodies, I want to try it all. One of the best recipes for me is the mango and pomelo sago and I am going to try this for pudding on the weekend. The illustrations in this book are fantastic, I have never been to Hong Kong but looking at the photographs I can imagine I am there.
Some of the recipes are a little bit adventurous but there are some really tasty straight forward ones that a novice such as me can manage. This book would make a superb Christmas present for,the foodie in the family, unless like me when it arrives you cannot bear to part with it.
PRODUCT: Hong Kong Diner: Recipes for Baos, Hotpots, Street Snacks and More

REVIEW_TITLE: A seriously impressive gift set for over 3's.
REVIEW:
Absolutely gorgeous gift set full of Radox products, for �10.00 what a lovely gift for any Frozen fans, and we have a few in our family. This gift set is impressive and comprises of:-
Radox shampoo and conditioner.
Bath and body wash.
Refreshing hand wash.
Else bath puff with rubber dolls head.
These products are all by Radox so you know they are completely safe for children. I love the designs on the front of the containers and the Elsa doll atop the bath puff which is plaited is such a novel idea. This gift set is such a good deal as individually I think the items will come to more than the price point of �10.00. No hesitation in recommending such a lovely gift set.
PRODUCT: Radox Kids Frozen Feel Enchanted Trio Gift Set

REVIEW:
These bathroom scales are very stylish and weigh accurately in lbs or kgs. Very slim and easy to use, just step on and it weighs you instantly. I have tested these against my weight watchers scales and they are spot on. Much simpler to use than my old ones and for the price are extremely good value for money.
To clean they just need a wipe over with a disc infecting wipe or a spray of bathroom cleaner and a buff with a soft dry cloth. They look really smart in my bathroom too, they are so classy that I am happy to leave these out. Really happy to recommend as for the price I do not think you will find better. I am delighted with these.
PRODUCT: A&D UC-502 Precision Bathroom Digital Scale

REVIEW:
This Santa is simply stunning when lit. There are so many LED lights that it is so bright against the dark night. I am going to put this in my hall window and when I tried him this evening he really does look absolutely superb from outside, and he looks pretty good inside.
You need a point close by to where you position him as the lead is quite short or you need extension leads. At under �20.00 there is �10.00 off the recommended price so this is a really good buy. Easy to pop up and he can be wall mounted to but looks brilliant with his stand. Christmas lights are becoming ever more advanced each year but this is one of the best I have seem for the price point. No hesitation at all in recommending,in fact I am going to look what other ones come in this super range.
PRODUCT: WeRChristmas Pre-Lit LED Santa Rope Light Window Silhouette, 61 cm - Multi-Colour

REVIEW:
I have never made an Angel cake before so cannot compare this non stick cake tin to any others as this is the first one I have used. I made an Angel cake using this pan for the first time yesterday and it turned out really well.
I have been wanting to make one for a while after tasting it at a Macmillan coffee morning, as I am always watching my weight this is a great cake to make as there is no fat in it. I poured the mixture in and was very apprehensive about not greasing the tin but there really is no need, the cake came out beautifully and the legs are fantastic toto support the cake when you turn it upside down, much better than using a wine bottle as my friend does.
Easy to wash and everyone seems to love the cake, I used a Mary Berry recipe and cheated with the topping, used a jar of lemon curd instead of making my own. Really recommend this tin and also the Mary Berry recipe.
PRODUCT: Chicago Metallic Professional Non-Stick Ring-Shaped Angel Food Cake Tin with Loose Base, 25 cm (10")

REVIEW: These lights are eight metres long and are a warm white as opposed to bright white which can be a bit harsh. They are on a silver wire and spaced evenly apart. Plugs into the mains and make a great spare set of lights for over the Christmas period. I am going to intertwine mine into a garland for the staircase and for the price I am really pleased. At under �10.00 these lights are excellent value for money and will brighten up many a winter's evening.
PRODUCT: Festive Productions 100L LED Lights with Clear Cable, Warm White

REVIEW:
I have very fine fly away hair that tends to be greasy, and I have lots of it. I had read good reports about this product and have always used salon based products but after reading about this make in the press I was keen to try.
First attempt I used too much and my hair was so greasy afterwards. Second attempt was much better, I used a small amount, probably the size of a two pence piece and massaged it completely into my hair and the result was very very good, I had volume and body when blow drying and my hair felt so soft, not coarse as it sometimes does due to too much blow drying. Another plus with this product is my hair will go an extra day now before I need to wash it which is a massive bonus for me as washing it every day is time consuming and every other is better for my hair too.
I am so pleased with the condition of my hair using this product and if you have hair like mine, fine, coloured and lots of it on the greasy spectre then I absolutely recommend as it works for me.
PRODUCT: COLOR WOW Carb Cocktail Bionic Tonic 200 ml

REVIEW:
The 1920's are vividly brought to life as the reader is transported into the lives of the Mitford's. Firstly though Louisa Cannon has a big problem! Her uncle. He is oppressive and very dangerous, and Louisa knows she needs to escape London. Delighted to secure a position as nursemaid at Astham Manor - home of the Mitford's she soon settles in. Then Florence Nightingale Shore,,goddaughter of her famous namesake is murdered on a train and Louisa,becomes involved with a young railway policemN and Nancy Mitford as the trio valiantly try to solve this murder.
I,was,surprised,to realise that this is based on a true story and the actual murder,has never been solved and the culprit never found. The solution to this murder is both feasible and credible.m,much of the action is,set,in the Mitford family home and I loved reading about the upper,classes in the the early 20th century but did empathise with the lives of the poor in London at that time who had the most miserable of existences. A thoroughly enjoyable read and I look forward to the next in this series.
PRODUCT: The Mitford Murders: Curl up with the must-read mystery this Christmas

REVIEW:
Twin sisters Zoe and Anna are identical twins but completely different in their personalities. Anna is an incurable romantic whilst Zoe is far more pragmatic and thinks Anna is deluded whencit comes to the opposite sex. They do not always get on and very often don't see eye to eye.
Anna decides in her wisdom to join an on line dating agency despite Zoe's grave misgivings. She warns Anna that not all men are what they seem and some are dishonest too. When Anna meets Nick Zoe feels he is just too good to be true. Tall, handsome with a good job and seemingly genuinely interested in Anna. Ignoring Zoe's warnings ringing inner ears Anna is in love!
Luckily Anna has Zoe watching out for her, she realises pretty early on that Nick is not who he EMS, after all as she reasons she has met men like him before. Zoe knows she can expose him but should she? Does she want to? Should Anna be left. To make sheer own mistakes and learn the hard way?
A tad predictable in places perhaps but the twists were good and I really enjoyed it.
PRODUCT: The Image of You: I thought I knew you. But you're a liar.

REVIEW:
As a mature lady I still find it somewhat unbelievable. I suffer from occasional skin breakouts as if I was a teenager. The upside of this is I have a clear complexion in between these bouts and I do not suffer with wrinkles. This time I have just returned from holiday and a change in water was responsible for the latest bout.
Over the years I have tried most products to relieve the redness and irritation with varying degrees of limited success. I applied this Proactive serum after cleansing and the difference this morning is tangible. My skin is free from soreness and the irritation is decidedly improved. Not only that but as soon as I applied last night my skin felt calmer and cooler almost immediately. Easy to apply it just slides over the skin with a deodorant type roller ball. It recommends you keep the serum in the fridge when opened which I think is advisable as the colder it is when applied to the skin the more immediate relief you get to alleviate the soreness. A recommended buy, I shal be re-buying and looking at other products in this range.
PRODUCT: Proactiv Redness Relief Serum

REVIEW_TITLE: A massive thank you from Teddi!!
REVIEW:
I have a very large cockapoo who has poodle fur which is fabulous but very very thick. Teddi is a groomer's nightmare. I brush him but his fur gets so matted because it so very thick. I never thought to try a de-tangle spray to be honest I did not know you could get them.
I used this last night before his daily brush and comb session which he hates but if I didn't do it he would have to be clipped really short as he gets so tangled. This product is such a help. After spraying the comb went through his ears like butter I could not believe it. Exactly the same all over him we finished in a quarter of the time it usually takes.
This to me is a miracle product and I am thrilled, will be re-ordering almost immediately. Absolutely recommend.
PRODUCT: Animology Knot Sure De-tangle Spray, 250ml

REVIEW:
This is good in principle. In theory this brow mascara is not easy to use unless you absolutely know how to apply. I didn't so it was a complete case of trial and error. If you have time to practise the results achieved are very professional but if you haven't used one before and use this when applying make up to go out - as I did, the results are hit and miss. It is basically a mascara for,your eyebrows.
I have always used a eyebrow defining pencil for achieving the illusion of thicker brows with a brush on the end for blending in. I have used one of these for years and always achieve the desired result. I find that you have more control with the pencil and it is easy to correct a mistake. The mascara is unforgiving as if a splodge gets on your brow you need to take it all off and start again. Personally I prefer a good eyebrow pencil and brush.
PRODUCT: Bourjois Number 002 Brow Design Mascara, 5 ml

REVIEW:
This is a really bright green colour, ideal for exceeding in the gym, running or any. Physical exercise. I trialled this for my Pilates class both times this week and found it easy to wear, and very comfortable next to my skin.
The top is long which is quite unusual, I have a lot of of exercise kit and this is longer than all my other tops. It is clingy too which is fine if you are super fit and slim, I am not bad but do have a couple of lumps and bumps, this top is unforgiving and does accentuate them. The fabric is excellent quality and helps eliminate perspiration when exercising. For the money this is a good product albeit a little bright and a very long length for an exercise top.
PRODUCT: Gregster Women's 12185 's Stop, Womens, 12185, light green

REVIEW:
I love boots, and I own a lot of pairs. These are without a doubt exceptional. They are one of the most well made top quality pair that I have ever owned. Everything about them oozes quality and style.
I could wax lyrical all day - these boots are lined with Gore-Tex which keeps the water out and the feet and legs snug. The leather is pliable and soft when the boots have been worn once or twice and cleaned. The buckles are attractive although I would not recommend undoing as they are tricky to do up and the boots are easily slipped on without undoing. The rubber sole gives a fantastic slip which for me is a godsend when out walking with two strong dogs on leads.
I have never bought footwear from Fly before but I certainly will in future, I am absolutely delighted with these and feel I will have many years use out of them. Calf length these look amazing with my Jeggings and skinny jeans. These boots are without doubt a fantastic investment purchase.
PRODUCT: Fly London Women's Gore-TEX SASI052FLY Boots, Black (Black), 4 UK 37 EU

REVIEW:
These are a good size for dog wipes and do the job up to a point. I have two cockapoos who love to roll in bird poo, fox poo, horse poo in fact any poo they can find. These wipes do the job in cleaning the poor off and taking away the disgusting smell. They are good also for wiping the delicate area and and are very hygienic. However I would not use them when my dogs have been in muddy water as they are jut not designed for cleaning off mud and dirt from mucky ponds. You need a bath full of warm soapy water for that not a dog wipe.
I do recommend for wiping down in general and for cleaning delicate areas, and the rough and smooth side have they purpose and work well but these wipes are wipes and no replacement for a good old fashioned dog bath.
PRODUCT: Animology Clean Sheets Dog Cleaning Wipes, Pack of 80

REVIEW:
This is a lovely dark green good quality garland. It measures 9' in length and fits on my bannister perfectly as my stairs turn half way up and this is the right size for the first section. For a normal straight up bannister I recommend getting two as one will go just over half way.
I have been looking at these garlands for a while now to dress the stairs for Christmas and this is the best quality at a very reasonable price. It is unadorned but will look really attractive when baubles and /or lights are added. I think for the price this is one of the best there is available at the moment. Happy to recommend for quality, colour and price.
PRODUCT: Festive Productions Green Christmas Garland, 270cm (9ft) x 25cm

REVIEW_TITLE: Looks the buisness and tastes the buisness.
REVIEW:
Well I have to say Nespresso have played a blinder with this machine. Several of my friends have Nespresso machines and they make a good cup of coffee. This machine takes coffee to the next level, the Vertuo plus pods are divine.
I have the silver machine which is a matt finish, looks expensive and classy on the worktop. It is an intelligent machine as it can determine how much water to add tothe cup size you select. There are four levels which you raise or lower to suit your cup size. The coffee is perfect and I cannot believe how simple it is to use, how easy it is to clean and just now good looking it is.
This is a serious piece of kit and is as good as coffee makers three times the price. Only problem I can forces is it might be a bit tricky to get the pods as this is a new machine but I think in the dedicated Nespresso outlets they should be available now. Absolutely love this machine and no hesitation in recommending for the quality of the taste of the coffee and for the stunning good looks of this machine. Absolutely love it.
PRODUCT: Nespresso Vertuo Plus, Silver finish by Magimix

REVIEW:
I have been using a Phillips Steam Generator for years and thought it fantastic. After using this one I cannot believe the difference,cthis without a doubt the Rolls Royce of steam generators. It is amazing. It is expensive but worth every penny that you pay.
This comes with a two year warranty, scratch resistant sole plate, and you need one temperature for everything from denim to satin. This cuts through the ironing like a knife through butter. It really is effortless,and the ironing looks as if has been professionally laundered. The water tank is large and I did an enormous load without having to refill once. In a purple colour which is very attractive and I have no hesitation in absolutely recommending this fantastic piece of kits which is so light to carry and easy to use. Worth ten stars.
PRODUCT: Philips GC9650/80 PerfectCare Elite Silence Steam Generator Iron (OptimalTemp No Fabric Burns Technology, 7.5 Bar, 500 g Steam Boost)

REVIEW_TITLE: One of the best loved children's series of all time.
REVIEW:
As a child I adored every book Enid Blyton ever wrote and the Faraway tree series was no exception. My own children re-read all my Enid Blyton classics and my husband spent many an evening reading the folk of the Faraway Tree to my children and he was quite addicted too.
This is a lovely story with fresh illustrations which I am sure will delight a whole new generation of young readers. A delightful book which I know my goddaughter is going to love and I cannot wait to introduce her to the rest of this fabulous series. Enid Bluton is a much loved author bu millions of children and their parents and now even grandparents. I hope these books will continue to delight or generations to come.
PRODUCT: Joe and the Magic Snowman: A Faraway Tree Adventure (Blyton Young Readers)

REVIEW:
Well if I could give this product ten stars I would. I am absolutely delighted with the results that I have achieved after trailing this product. My poor nails were in a sorry state after having gel nails for a wedding. My nails were dry, brittle and in general poor health.
After just one treatment I noticed an improvement almost immediately. I applied two coats for the intense treatment as recommended and my nails were brighter and glossy. One of the best aspects of this treatment for me is how quickly my nails were hydrated and moisturised and they seem harder too.
The treatment contains seaweed, peptides, kale and something called nitrocellulose together with the magic ingredient keratin, which works on regenerating the nails. This is a miracle cure in a bottle and I am delighted with it, cannot recommend highly enough if you need a make over for your nails.
PRODUCT: Nails Inc Gel Rehab Treatment & Base Coat

REVIEW:
This is a beautiful calming dog spray which smells amazing and is easy to apply. I have a very very anxious and timid rescue poo and one bomb proof poo and they both smell absolutely gorgeous. I sprayed it on my happy go lucky poo and it is a nice gentle spray and he loved it. I found it easier to spray onto a glove for my little rescue dog and then smoothed it on to his skin. They both enjoyed the fuss and they smell gorgeous. I am not sure if it is helping Ben with his anxieties but as it is the start of the firework season I am hoping that together with all the other measures in place as well this will help too.
Absolutely recommend anyway for the aroma, they look fab and smell fab too.
PRODUCT: Animology Paws & Relax Aromatherapy Dog Spray 250ml

REVIEW:
This is a top quality sports shirt in breathable polyester. Well made in a lovely stretchy fabric this is so easy to wear. True to size the colour is a lovely peachy coral so don't be fooled by the colour being depicted as lobster.
I wore for my Pilates class and it was so comfortable. Not at all clingy and absorbed the moisture perfectly. A light easy to wear top that is true to size and just perfect for keep fit or running.
PRODUCT: Gregster 12189 Sports Shirt, Womens, 12189, Lobster

REVIEW_TITLE: Without doubt th only baby book you will ever need.
REVIEW:
I only wish this book had been written when my children were new born babies. It is really fantastic and truly the only baby book you will ever need as a first or even second time mums. It really helps you to read your baby's needs and shows and explains how every new born is uniquely different.
This book is full of common sense advice that helps new parents realise how we all feel the same panic and helpfulness. Reading this makes you realise that youacrually can relax and enjoy your baby. Absolutely recommend.
PRODUCT: The Baby Detective: Solve your baby problems your way

REVIEW_TITLE: Wonderful products in a beautiful Christmas Cracker.
REVIEW:
This is a super little indulgence from luxury company GATINEAU Paris. Nth is is a gorgeous cracker which makes a fabulous decoration on the Christmas Tree or a lovely Christmas treat for anyone who cares about their beauty regime.
I adore GATINEAU products and this cracker contains the Defiloft 3D revolumosing lip are plus a targeted wrinkle corrector. You need to bear in mind these are 10ml trial sizes which used correctly will last about two months and are ideal for travelling.
The lip care is amazing, it has lavender extract and Shea butter which soothes and softens the lips and a hyalurenic acid for plumping and smoothing the lips. The targeted wrinkle corrector has collagen to plump and smooth the skin with vitamins C E and F. These little treats make a fantastic introduction to GATINEAU or for regular devotees like me a fabulous treat. Fantastic.

REVIEW:
This is the first in a series of crime novels featuring DI Adam Fawley who comes across as a thoroughly good guy if somewhat flawed who has a tragedy in his not too distant past. This is alluded to throughout the story and bit by bit we are drip fed what has happened to his young son.
This is not the main plot of the story though, an unconventional read with no set chapters. Every section though has dates and times and tells us how many days before the disappearance of the main character Daisy who is eight or how many days after. Bit by bit we build up a family picture of Daisy's life with BRry her father, Sharon her mother, and Leo their adopted son. Where is Daisy? Someone must know. There are so many twists and turns in this book it kept me reading long into the night.
The twist at the end is legend and the author has played a blinder with this crime novel, there are many if not too many crime novels out there centring on child abduction, cruelty by social media etc but this one is unique in its telling and I for one cannot wait for the next in this fantastic series. If I could give it ten stars I would, I am bereft to have finished it.

REVIEW_TITLE: Finally found the wallet I've been looking for
REVIEW:
I hate chunky wallets, so I've been buying progressively smaller ones over the years and slimming down what I carry in them, but with this I think I've found my perfect combination of size and capacity.
The four pockets are a perfect combo. The transparent one holds my driving license, a book of stamps and store loyalty card. The outer pocket is perfect for my main credit card that I use all the time, with the other two inner pockets comfortably holding my three less used (but still useful to have) cards. The pockets are roomy enough that the cards go in and out easily, and the whole thing is made from tough materials that should last a while.
Because this is made of nylon, the material is much less bulky than that in similar leather wallets, which means it folds down flatter. The whole package is only a few millimeters thicker than the cards would be it they were stacked on their own.
I particularly like the external pocket, which makes finding my main card at the supermarket checkout a super speedy.
Overall, perfect for what I need it for, it holds just enough cards to be useful in almost the smallest package possible, while still making them easily accessible.

Here's why I don't give it 5 stars:
* It's too bright. The brightness is suitable for a TV screen, but up close it dazzles and hurts your eyes. Put your face 50cm from your TV and you might see what I mean. I found that setting the brightness to 0 (zero) was a comfortable setting. The default brightness seems to be 100%, and it resets to 100 whenever you switch colour modes between 'Color Temperature', 'sRGB' and 'User Define'.
* Colour is too yellow. My wife's an artist. She said the balance was too yellow. I didn't notice/care, however it was possible to fix (see below).
* There are small shadowy patches all along the bottom and sides which are more prominent at certain viewing angles. Not a big deal, we only notice when looking at pages with white backgrounds.
* Software and drivers: monitor comes with a CD which opens a page with a link to Philips web site! Sort of a waste of time! Also the web site is not required, because Windows already has a copy of the best driver... On Windows 10, if you open 'Display Settings', and click 'Display adapter properties', then select 'Monitor' (tab), then click the button labelled 'Properties', then click tab 'Driver', then click the button 'Update Driver', you can select the option to 'Search automatically...' and Windows will install the correct driver, exactly the same as the one on Philips' web site. DON'T BOTHER installing the software program called 'SmartControl' - it's not smart. The program is 80MB+ (large), it does almost nothing, it requires admin rights to run, and half the features are disabled for this monitor when connected over hdmi. If you want software to control brightness and contrast, look at your graphics card instead. I don't know why hardware manufacturers still peddle such lame software with their products - if you can't write good software, why assault us with it? You only need Windows and a graphics driver, no 3rd party rubbish.
We have settled on 30% brightness, 'Custom Define' colours set to R:85, G:85, B:100. At higher brightness from 50%+, we found the best reproduction was R:95, G:95, B:100.
We wondered whether 32" would be a good size for a desktop monitor, with Windows 10. When viewing web sites etc from approx 50cm, Windows 10 text looks a little bit pixelated. Graphics and video look smooth, vibrant and beautiful. I think 28" is probably the optimal size for an HD monitor, 32" is stretching things a little too much. Saying that, I'm happy with it, you can sit back and watch comfortably from further away. The IPS screen means it doesn't look shadowy or negative when viewing from wide angles, but don't expect miracles, it's still best when viewed head on, from a narrower angle.

REVIEW:
This is great. I have connected a Yamaha Piano to Windows 10 PC. You need some midi software to make use of it.
As has been said, the plug marked IN means going into the PC/USB, so must be connected to the OUT port of the keyboard. If the instrument only has OUT that's fine, you can use it to record midi scores on the PC.
The OUT socket means going out of the PC/USB, so connects to the IN socket of any midi receiver. My piano has an IN socket and can play the midi tracks being sent from the PC.
If you need to lengthen the cable, a USB 2.0 extension is easy. It's also possible to get midi extension leads.
The cable has 3 lights on the controller. When connected to USB the red light (on the right) goes on. When an instrument/device is connected, the green light (left) should constantly flicker. The 3rd light in the centre is blue, and it lights whenever a midi note is either sent or received through the cable. For example, a piano key turns the blue light on when it's pressed and then again when released - it shows data is flowing.
The lights all prove useful when trying to configure your clunky music software, at least you can use the lights to see if data is travelling, even if no sound is coming out. If the red and green lights are on, I'd say you've got the connection working, then it's a matter of setting up the software. The music software developers haven't worked out how to provide an it-just-works interface yet, it usually takes hours/days of messing about.

REVIEW:
This camera has only minor issues. I bought this and another for different areas (ieGeek 1080P Home IP Camera Wireless WiFi Indoor Video Monitoring Security Surveillance Pan/Tilt Camera with Night Vision Two-Way Audio Motion Detection (White)) which proved slightly better value. Both cameras are equivalent in picture and sound quality and features, but the ieGeek is cheaper.
Field of view is wide, night vision good, software adequate - camera is controlled and configured with a smartphone app called "MIPC". Hardware-wise, many of this type of camera are similar, it's the software that marks them apart.
Set-up worked like clockwork - I plugged in the ethernet cable to set it up, installed MIPC which scans a barcode on the camera to add it to the app. I set up WiFi settings while connecting over ethernet, then disconnected the ethernet cable.
Pros and cons...
Cons:
* Software hard to figure sometimes, you must play with it on and off for a couple of days in advance to get to know it before using it for anything serious.
* Motion detection is triggered every time you move the camera by remote control - if you have alerts switched on, you get interrupted when trying to adjust the angle of the camera.
* Adjusting the viewing angle is done by swiping the screen; when you're remote there is a delay between the swipe and the movement, and I think ieGeek's style of using arrows works better - also the direction of swipe wasn't intuitive as to which way the lens moved. It's fine when you're on home wifi, but from a remote location the delay is tortuous when you've just moved the lens the opposite way from your intention.
* No email of snapshot on motion detection - it records them on SD. ieGeek emails the snapshot image to you.
* Motion detection sensitivity can be set on a scale of 1 to 100, who's got time to fine tune to that extent?
* You need an SD card. You can see through the camera wiithout one, and also receive motion alerts, but with an SD card it can record whenever it detects motion. I recommend a 32GB card unless you want to record continuously. Something like this will do: SanDisk Ultra 32 GB MicroSDHC UHS-I Memory Card with SD Adapter - Standard Packaging
* Motion alerts are sent while the app is running - I wanted to enable motion detection for recording clips, but prevent app notifications. I couldn't work out if it was possible.
Pros:
* Long ethernet cable
* USB power adapter and reasonably long USB cable, obviously you can lengthen it with an extension if need be.
* Software feels a little more sophisticated than ieGeek's Sricam app.
* Worked flawlessly
PRODUCT: Smonet 1080P HD WiFi IP Security Camera Wireless Security Camera System Home Monitor with Two-Way Audio Motion Detection Night Vision

REVIEW:
This camera is not without issues, but for �55 it proved to be better value than one other I tried (details at end).
Field of view is wide, night vision very good, software adequate - camera is controlled and configured with a smartphone app called "Sricam". Hardware-wise, many of this type of camera are similar, it's the software that marks them apart.
The feature I liked most was that it emailed a snapshot image when motion was detected.
Set-up worked like clockwork - I had read some reviews of people who had problems, so followed the instructions to the letter and it worked first time - note that you start by plugging it into your router with the supplied ethernet cable, set it up (e.g. enter wifi settings) and then remove the ethernet cable.
Pros and cons...
Cons:
* Software hard to figure sometimes, but ok once you've played with it for a day or two and worked out what things mean. If you plan on using this for any serious reasons, e.g. watching your house while your away, you MUST play with it on and off for a couple of days in advance to get to know it.
* Ethernet and power cables are short, at best you must place it within 1.8 metres of a socket. Power is a fixed transformer to round plug (not USB) so can't lengthen it.
* White camera comes with black cable.
* Email alert configuration was hardest for me: software didn't give any clue when it failed - it just times out, or fails silently. You need to enter an email account's smtp server, through which to send emails. I created a new outlook account just for this purpose (because it's really NOT secure to put your normal email password into potentially unsafe or hackable emailing devices). Problem one - Outlook account needed to be verified via settings accessed from a desktop web browser before it would send any mail AND I also enabled IMAP mode; then my recipient address (gmail) put all the messages into spam, so I couldn't see them - they were tucked away in the gmail spam folder. If your SMTP settings are ok, the camera software will accept your settings and return to menu when you press 'save', but if not, it will time out.
* SECURITY - I couldn't be sure that the password to start the app was sent securely. When I tried to reset my password it sent a link to a non-secure web site. Any company that does this doesn't take security seriously. If your password travels across the web unencrypted, any server it passes through may monitor it. Anyone with your id and password will be able to log in and watch your camera feed.
* You need an SD card. You can see through the camera wiithout one, and also receive motion alerts, but with an SD card it can record for 1/2/3 minutes whenever it detects motion. I recommend a 32GB card unless you want to record continuously. It says that for SD cards larger than 32GB you need to format them to FAT32, which can't be done on Windows without special software. A 32GB card should carry around 10 hours of footage, e.g. something like this will do: SanDisk Ultra 32 GB MicroSDHC UHS-I Memory Card with SD Adapter - Standard Packaging
* Manual focus - you have to choose your focal distance by twisting the lens.
Pros:
* Not too expensive
* Good remote control
* Worked flawlessly
* Good night vision - those dots around the lens are infrared lights.
I needed 2 cameras, and since I couldn't be sure in advance if this camera was any good, I also bought a Smonet Smonet 1080P HD WiFi IP Security Camera Wireless Security Camera System Home Monitor with Two-Way Audio Motion Detection Night Vision
I preferred the ieGeek, it had slightly better night vision, and the Smonet didn't have an email alert. Both cameras have similar pictures, viewing angles, and sound. The Smonet's software ("MIPC") was slightly more sophisticated but equally vague in places. Smonet is a little more elegant, has a USB charger with long USB cable, and a longer ethernet cable.
