REVIEW_TITLE: View these as hi-fi quality headphones that can also be used with a phone/tablet if you want to get your money's worth
REVIEW:
For: Great sound with suitable sources; beautiful quality materials and construction; future update to lightning connection
Against: You MUST run them in before trying out; phone/streaming use won't get the best out of them; expensive
This is a long review but if you're considering paying �700 for a pair of headphones you want to see more than 10 words, before splashing out right? I know I would and in fact I did a whole load of searching reviews before finally ordering a pair.
The P9 Signatures certainly look how you would imagine they should for the money. The smell and feel of the leather, the weight in the hand, the smoothness of the engineered parts, the soft case and the three supplied leads all give the impression of quality. Factor in that registered users will receive a fourth lead with lightning connector and DAC early next year and you realise this is a quality package. They are quite large, although I have big ears and the cups only just went over them. However they are pretty comfortable; I wear glasses and unlike some over-ear cans I didn't find that my specs were clamped awkwardly.
I'd read a couple of reviews saying that the P9s need to be run in for at least 30 hours before they loosen up and sound at their best. From prior experience with the original P5s I knew that to be the case. However I couldn't resist giving them a quick try out so plugged them into my phone and streamed a random song through Apple Music. They sounded terrible. A lot of detail was retrieved but the sound was compressed, dull and nowhere near as good as my Sennheiser Momentum 2 over-ears from the same device.
So I plugged them into my old iPod, set it to shuffle, cranked up the volume and left them playing together in the spare room for a day and a bit. I grew up with the hi-fi principle of 'garbage in, garbage out' or, in other words, that putting expensive speakers or headphones on to a cheap source cannot magically create great sound. The P9s are marketed as 'Made for iThing' which could give the impression that they are designed purely for that purpose. In reality all it means is that the remote on the attached lead will control the Apple device and that the device in turn will be able to produce sufficient volume for the headphones to be usable.
My point is that the P9 Signatures are too good for that purpose - you will only get the best out of them when used with high quality sources. After 30 hours of running in, I tried them again with my iPhone and Apple Music streaming. The sound had definitely opened out and become much more natural but I wasn't convinced this was how �700 headphones should sound. The P9s were now better than the Momentum 2s but not enough to warrant the extra money.
My next test then was to use my Chord Mojo DAC connected to a MacBook Pro running Audirvana. Music was CD quality or better FLAC files, including some hi-res recordings downloaded from Bowers & WIlkins' site (you get 3 months free access when you register). I started with a favourite album - Peter Gabriel's So, the remastered edition. What a revelation! This setup was a much better match of similar quality source material, playback software, DAC and headphone. The sound was spacious, detailed, natural and so enjoyable I played the whole album. The same thing happened with a hi-res version of Holst's The Planets: my intention was to listen to Venus but forgot and listened to the end of the suite.
There's a tendency when testing something high quality to throw great recordings at it to hear something you've not heard before. I had fun doing that for a few hours before trying music I love but which are not great recordings. The P9s continued to dig lots of information out and it was still enjoyable to listen to at CD quality or above. Low bit-rate files are shown up in comparison though, so anyone buying these purely for portable streaming use are likely to be disappointed. The P9s won't appeal to bass-heads (although bass is certainly not lacking) and you may find the sound is tuned more towards classical than heavy metal but put them with a comparable source and they're great.
PRODUCT: Bowers & Wilkins P9 Signature HiFi Over Ear Headphones, Wired, Italian Leather

REVIEW_TITLE: Stylish, portable and splash-proof. Limited to Bluetooth and aux only though.
REVIEW:
Summary - if you want a portable, splash-proof, Bluetooth speaker and aren't bothered about aptX then this is a good choice. Don't get the grey one if you like chocolate!
Like Liberatone's Zipp Mini, the One Style is labelled as 'Made for' Apple devices. Unlike the Zipp Mini though, AirPlay is not an option so Bluetooth levels the playing field somewhat. To get the most out of it though does require the Liberatone app, available from the Apple App Store and Google Play. There is also an aux input for mini headphone jack connections hidden under a rubber flap on the back, along side the mini-USB charging port. A charging lead is provided but no mains plug so you'll need to charge from a computer or use a separate adaptor. AptX Bluetooth does not appear to be supported, but Bluetooth 4.1 is so the 4G signal quality of a connected phone is not impaired.
That rubber flap is important as the One Style is splash-proof, as also evidenced by the rubber strip that covers the edges and also provides the handle/hook on the corner. It's a nice looking device though the grey material covering the drivers is easily marked. Like if someone in your house picks it up while eating a Cadbury's Flake. Most of the chocolate marks came out but not all! If you do intend taking it out and about you might want to consider a darker colour.
Once paired, from the Liberatone app you can play 5 preset radio stations, but these can't be selected from the device directly. You can also adjust the sound, choosing from an adjustment ranging from smooth jazz to rock. Otherwise select your music app of choice and off you go. The sound comes out of both sides of the One Style but each side sounds slightly different: the front (with the volume and control dial) has more of the midrange and bass while the rear has more of the treble.
This can be a little strange at first. I found the most balanced sound came with the One Style sitting edge-on facing me but it then feels like it's not playing 'to' you. Putting it on a shelf with the rear wall to bounce the sound off worked better. There is plenty of detail to the sound, decent bass and it goes pretty loud. As a Bluetooth speaker I prefer the Soundblaster Roar, which is easier to place with the sound coming from front and top but the Roar is heavier and doesn't have a convenient carry handle (nor is it splash-proof).
PRODUCT: Libratone One Style Wireless Splash Proof Bluetooth Speaker - Cloudy Grey

REVIEW:
This is a very easy to use and accurate detector. You simply hold it against the wall and switch it on. At first the screen shows a series of instructions on how to use the detector. You then select what you want to detect and slide the device from side to side. There is sound, a picture on the display and the coloured ring changes colour when something is detected. You can then mark the position through the hole in the detector.
None of these detectors are totally foolproof and do take a bit of getting used to as there is an art. They also work better on newer houses with regular thickness walls. In my experience I use multiple passes at different heights of the wall to ensure that I have found what I am looking for. This one seems to cope as well as my other Bosch professional detector, but this has the added bonus of the easy to use display.
I would have liked a case to have been included for protection when not in use, and the back of the detector is just hard plastic so it can mark the walls if you are heavy handed, but as a detector this does do the job very well.
PRODUCT: Bosch 0603681300 UniversalDetect Digital Detector - Green

REVIEW:
This is a very effective product suitable for the home user or semi professional. Not much bigger than a mobile phone it is easy to use - just switch on and within a second or two the image is displayed on the screen. There are buttons for lamp brightness, image rotation and photo capture and playback. The camera wand is permanently fixed to the unit and is semi flexible such that you bend it into shape and it stays that way.
Image quality is good enough for almost any use. It focuses down to a couple of centimeters and the light is bright enough to see things at a good distance. The image capture works well - I have included a couple of photos to show the detail - the unit stores up to 8 images locally or you can add a 4-32 meg SD card for more capacity or to transfer the photos off the unit. The screen is clear and bright enough but if you use it outdoors then your will struggle.
There are a couple of attachments which include a 90 degree mirror and a magnet which is strong enough to pick up a fork so will manage a lost nut or key with no problems. These fit securely and easily and store in the included pouch.
Overall this is a well designed and very handy device to have around the house, or in the toolbox.

In use it works as fast as the stock Samsung cable for both charging and data transfer.
So overall this cable looks good and performs well with the added bonus of extra durability so I can highly recommend it.
PRODUCT: Belkin Duratek 1.2 m USB-C to USB-A Premium Charge and Sync Cable Compatible with MacBook Pro/MacBook/Google Pixel/Samsung Galaxy S8/S8+ and Other USB-C Devices (USB-IF Certified) - Rose Gold

REVIEW:
The products contained inside the set are all of the normal high Baylis And Harding quality. They smell nice and work well on the body and there is certainly enough in here for a few weekends away. The bag looks nice, but obviously at this price is made from leather effect material and is probably not durable enough to use as an everyday bag.
As a gift set it is okay as it stands, but the products inside are wrapped in scraps of white tissue and held in place with tatty corrugated cardboard, so you may consider rewrapping the contents to make it look a bit mor special.
Overall though this is indeed a nice gift set suitable for a few weekends away.
PRODUCT: Baylis & Harding La Maison - Cr�me Brulee & Cocoa Luxury Backpack

REVIEW_TITLE: Easy to use and very impressive effect
REVIEW:
The hardest thing about using this kit was getting the timing right. On our first attempt at a trial nail we didn't quite wait long enough to apply the top coat and the whole thing went wrong. But after this initial fail we managed to get a brilliant look every time. Even for a novice it is easy and the effect is very striking.
I would have liked proper instructions - the only ones are written on the back of the box - but otherwise this is a very easy to use kit to get a very striking effect.
PRODUCT: Sally Hansen Salon Chrome Kit, Holographic 130

REVIEW_TITLE: Bright and vivid colours but the cable could be longer
REVIEW:
Put simply this is a 1 metre strip of covered LEDs with a sticky back and an integrated plug and control unit which allow you to select brightness and colour by using one of two buttons.
It works very well. The light it provides is bright and there are a good range of vivid colours. You can trim the length if you so wish. The adhesive sticks to almost any surface and holds the lights firmly. The coating on the strip means that it it easily wipe cleanable.
I would have liked the cable to be longer and more flexible - you are limited in placement options and the white coloured wire is quite visible due to its thickness.
There are cheaper options, but in my experience you do get what you pay for to a certain extent. The moulded cable and integrated power supply on this mean that it is more durable and safer than most of the cheaper options.
Overall then I do like this strip. It does exactly as advertised but could do with a longer cable.
PRODUCT: Philips MyLiving Colour Changing LED Light Strips, Multi-Colour, 1 m, 7 Watt

REVIEW_TITLE: Works very well but wouldn't connect to WiFi
REVIEW:
The results from this cooker are nothing short of amazing. Plenty of videos and guides online will show you how to use it to cook the best steaks you have tasted. Easily and cleanly. We have done expensive steaks, cheap steaks, a roast joint of beef, belly pork, fruit compote, soups and much more. It's a brilliant way to cook stuff.
To use it you seal your food in a plastic bag (we bought a vacuum sealer and bags for this but you can use freezer bags if you like) then set the temperature and time and leave it. The food cooks to the desired temperature and then stays there. So for steaks or roast you choose exactly how you like it done and then forget about it. When it comes to serve, remove it from the bag and sear it in a pan or the oven and you are done.
The only issue I have with this is that it will not connect to my WiFi. I have tried Android and iOS apps, restarting everything multiple times, but in the end I gave up. It isn't really a big issue as setting time and temperature is easy enough from the device itself, and the app works without a connection, but it is still a flaw.
However overall this is a very effective device which cooks many foods to perfection with very little fuss. Recommended.
PRODUCT: iVide Cooker by SousVideTools.com

REVIEW_TITLE: A nice set, probably more for display than play though.
REVIEW:
This is a decent Lego kit. It took me just over four hours to complete it, although for half an hour I was also talking to Three customer services so you could maybe shave a bit of time off that.
The instructions are clear and very easy to understand, and at no point did I get confused or put things in the wrong place. The parts come in eight bags, with each bag being opened when directed in the instructions. This means that it is easy enough to find the right bits - at least for the first assembly. I am a bit disappointed that Lego no longer include chocolate box style inserts in the box to separate the pieces for storage. No pieces were missing, although I did have a few extras (see photos). A disassembly tool is included which works very well and saves your fingernails.
The set includes a few action figures in case it is to be used for play, although it does feel a bit flimsy to be played with as a toy. The arms and fingers move and the missile launcher thingys open up and you can launch them with a flick of your finger. Despite having just the one wheel there is an innocuous brace behind that which allows it to stand unaided.
Overall this is a good set, probably more for display than play. And if you take it apart then it will probably take longer to resemble than initially due to the numbered bags.
PRODUCT: LEGO UK 70632 Quake Mech Playset

REVIEW:
This product works well. You charge it up using a standard micro USB cable - which is included in the box - then switch it on and cycle between heat, heat and light, and heat, light and sonic modes. Then you just gently move it around clean and lightly moisturised eyes to stimulate the blood flow and hopefully reduce bags and dark rings.
It feels nice. Once you have the technique then it is a relaxing experience. Time will tell how effective it is, and this will vary per person, but using heat and vibration to stimulate blood flow to an area is a proven technique.
PRODUCT: HoMedics Eye Revive Luxe - Refresh Tired Eyes with Massage, Reduce Dark Circles, Boost Circulation, Warm Sonic Vibration, Relax and Soothe Tiredness Feeling, Red Light Therapy to Improve Skin Firmness

REVIEW:
These headphones are a bit more of a job to set up than most as they need an optical connection from the rear of the PS4 to the dongle to get the full surround. This also means that you will not get full surround unless the device you are connecting to has an optical output so if you are buying these for a PC then check carefully.
The instructions are clear and easy to understand with screen shots of the relevant screens from the PS4 to help with the setup. All cables are included and are of a very good quality, as is the build quality of the headphones themselves.
In use I found the sound to be good for gaming but not the best I have heard. The surround works very well depending upon the support from your game and adds a lot of atmosphere. In multiplayer shooters it can give you an edge as you can sometimes hear an enemy long before you see them. There is lots of midrange and highs but I find the bass a bit lacking. The microphone is good.
They are reasonably comfortable but the vinyl ear cups did mean I got a bit hot after a while.
Overall I like these phones. The audio quality could be better but the surround sound works very well. Just check that these are compatible if you are considering them for anything other than a PS4.
PRODUCT: Razer Thresher 7.1 Playstation 4 (PS4) Wireless Gaming Headset, 7.1 Surround Sound with Retractable Microphone

REVIEW: This set of shampoo, conditioner and spray has been very well received by my daughter. She has long, fine hair and loves the extra volume and shine that she gets when using the set. The bonus is that this all comes in a really substantial sized gift set ready for Christmas.
PRODUCT: TIGI Bed Head Size Matters Gift Set

REVIEW_TITLE: A very neat and efficient package
REVIEW: The idea of having a juicer and a zester in one is a good one. And this product does both things very well. The reamer fits well in your hand and is comfortable enough to use - although a little bit harder than a reamer with a built in strainer and bowl. The zester is very efficient and does a great job of removing the zest. And the whole thing is dishwasher safe and fits neatly into any kitchen drawer. Recommended.
PRODUCT: KitchenCraft Healthy Eating 2-in-1 Citrus Reamer / Lemon Zester - Yellow / Green

REVIEW: My daughter loves this product. She has long fine hair and regularly straightens it so it does get very dry and fly away. Recently she has been using pure coconut oil, but finds that this product smells better and leaves her hair a lot softer and with a nice shine. Highly recommended.
PRODUCT: L'Oreal Elvive Extraordinary Oil Coconut Hair Mask 300ml

REVIEW: I loved the rebooted adult Penguin books and have the whole set. For me this book tries to do the same thing, but falls very short of the mark. It is very disjointed and the humour jumps around too much for there to be any flow to the "story". I won't be reading any of the others in the series.
PRODUCT: Mr Greedy Eats Clean to Get Lean (Mr. Men for Grown-ups)

REVIEW: A nicely presented gift set, albeit in a very flimsy box, of a decent range of Dove products. The body wash smells nice and leaves the skin clean and soft. The body lotion complements the wash well and leaves the skin even softer. The deodorant is non irritating on gentle skin. And the final part of the set is a reasonable quality bag to keep all the stuff in for traveling. Recommended.
PRODUCT: Dove Love Collection Trio with Spa Bag

REVIEW_TITLE: A very nice tray for crispier food
REVIEW: This is a very nice very heavy duty baking tray with air holes to help crisp up your food. It works very well - biscuits, pizza and chips are all made more crispy by the holes allowing condensation to escape. The non stick works too, cleaning by hand is a breeze. As a tip - because the pan is thicker than normal then I found it works best pre-heated otherwise it takes a long time to warm and start to cook the food.
PRODUCT: Chicago Metallic Professional Perforated Non-Stick Baking Tray, 38 cm x 25 cm (15" x 10")

REVIEW:
This is a high quality stainless steel cocktail shaker with a very different brass and Matt black finish. It comes with a strainer and a measuring cup. The body join has a silicone seal and fits together firmly whilst the lid just presses on, similar to other shakers. There is an integral coarse strainer under the lid for large ice cubes and so on. The finish looks to be durable as long as the hand wash only instructions are followed.
Overall this is a very nice looking and well performing set.
PRODUCT: BarCraft Luxury Stainless Steel Cocktail Making Kit - Brass Finish (3-Piece Gift Set)

REVIEW_TITLE: Accurate but the pins are incredibly stiff
REVIEW: The pins on this gauge are a lot finer than my previous (plastic) contour gauge, which means that it has a lot higher resolution. This allows for a very accurate copy of your template item. However the pins on mine are very very stiff, needing a considerable amount of force to be moved. Whilst this does ensure that the design is retained, it does mean that it takes a lot of force against the object to be copied to get the pins to move, so much so that it left an imprint on my plaster coving. It may wear in over time, and I have added some oil to help it along, but for now it only gets three stars.
PRODUCT: General Tools 837 Contour Gauge Duplicator, 6-Inch (837G)

REVIEW_TITLE: A great book to keep you amused for a few minutes a day
REVIEW:
I am a big fan of bits and pieces of useless information, so for years have enjoyed books full of the stuff. This book is therefore currently at the top of my reading list when I have a few minutes sat down with not much else to entertain me. Each page has a selection of short anecdotes, facts or stories related to food. Most of them are one or two sentences long, and almost all of them are eyebrow raisers.
Reading it in one go is not recommended as fact overload sets on very quickly, but to pick up and put down a couple of times a day this is a great book.
PRODUCT: The Gannet's Gastronomic Miscellany

REVIEW_TITLE: Longer and thicker - performs very well
REVIEW:
This cable is slightly thicker than the stock USB cable included with my Galaxy S8, and is therefore slightly less flexible. It also follows the current trend of having non existent strain relief so will need to be treated with care. However on the upside it is a lot longer than my stock cable and performs as good as the stock cable. And all backed up by the Belkin name.
Recommended
PRODUCT: Belkin 2.0 USB-A to USB-C Charge Sync Cable, 3 m, White

REVIEW_TITLE: An excellent addition for work and play
REVIEW:
This is a smart looking and very effective device which has allowed me to connect my Samsung Galaxy S8 to my TV via HDMI. I simply plugged in the HDMI cable and attached it to my phone to mirror the display almost instantly. There is very little lag which allows me to show photos, videos, games and more. The cable is about 10 cm long and reasonably flexible, and the whole thing rolls up into a space not much larger than a USB stick, which allows me to carry one device to and from work instead of a selection of USB sticks.
Be aware that this will not work on every USB C device - my Galaxy A5 wasn't compatible - but otherwise I highly recommend it.
PRODUCT: USB C to HDMI Adapter (4K@60Hz), QacQoc USB-C Male to 4K HDMI Female Adapter, Supports 4K/60Hz, for the New Macbook/Chromebook Pixel/Samsung Galaxy Note 8 / S8 / S8 Plus and More (Gray)

REVIEW_TITLE: A very good value and sturdy pole
REVIEW: This pole doesn?t the job very well. It is made of aluminium so feels very solid and durable but is quite a bit heavier than plastic poles. Although this does mean that it is a lot more stable and potentially will take more abuse. When extended it feels equally solid, and the camera is controllable with a good amount of precision. The extension part of the pole is a satin black to minimise glare. The remote is held firmly in position and is in the right place for finger or thumb operation, although it is a bit rotated from the camera when the pole is locked at its full extent, but you do get used to this. I?m very happy with it.
PRODUCT: AmazonBasics GoPro Remote Pole

REVIEW_TITLE: A good value pot which works well
REVIEW: A nice looking large sized pan which has a handy clear lid and silicone non slip handles. The pan heats up quickly and evenly on my induction hob and is oven and dishwasher safe. The pan feels a bit on the thin and tinny side, but the base is thick An does the whole thing works very well. It is also backed up by a five year guarantee. Recommended.
PRODUCT: Tower Essentials Casserole Dish, Stainless Steel

REVIEW:
This is an excellent cleaner with very powerful suction and highly effective filtration which means that there is no doggy smell from the carpets when cleaning up after pets. It is made from very high quality components that feel like they will last for years. The design is good too - the unit is compact and relatively light so it follows you around with the minimum of effort, relieving pressure on your arms and wrists compared to an upright. Suction is amazing - at full power it sticks to the carpet and is quite hard to move around - but there is a pressure relief valve on the handle to release anything you inadvertently suck up like a rug without switching off the power.
It comes with a good selection of tools - in addition to a bristle brush, extension nozzle and mini head you also get a long flexible nozzle for under furniture or behind car seats and a hard floor head for ensuring very effective cleaning of vinyl or laminates. The cable is long enough to do almost the whole floor of a house without changing sockets and retracts smoothly with the press of a foot.
It does have the downside of requiring replacement bags which will cost money, but as I said before this is balanced by the more effective filtration and smell removal over bagless cleaners. And the lack of rotating brush does mean that dog hairs take a few passes to remove. But overall this is a very powerful and effective cleaner.
PRODUCT: Miele Compact C2 XXL PowerLine SDRE1 Cylinder Vacuum Cleaner with 1200W Power in Obsidi

REVIEW_TITLE: A very high quality and effective cleaner.
REVIEW:
This is a very well designed and built cleaner which has high quality durable components.
It has been a while since I used a cleaner with a bag as opposed to bagless and I was pleasantly surprised. The suction is very good. So much so that it can be hard to move it across the carpet on full power. There is also less of a smell than when using bagless cleaners - we have two dogs and I currently live in an old house where the previous occupants had six dogs - and the smell from a bagless can be quite overpowering after a few minutes. The filtration seems to be a lot better at removing said canine odours. Cleaning performance is good but the lack of a rotating brush does mean that dog hairs take a few passes to remove.
It comes with a good selection of attachments - a small brush, a crevice nozzle and a mini head for furniture or car seats. All of these bits store securely at the base of the pipe. The pipe itself is thick and durable - unlike our latest bagless - and long enough to almost do a full flight of stairs. There is a pressure relief valve on the handle to release sucked up rugs without having to switch off the power. The cable retracts with the press of a foot and there is a place to store the handle with the cleaner upright so it does not take up too much space. The rotating casters mean that the base unit follows easily around the house so overall there is a lot less stress on your wrists than when using an upright.
Overall this is a very good cleaner. Quality and performance are good and the components are durable. It is quite expensive and will require replacement bags, but the balance is that in my opinion the filtration is better than with a bagless.
PRODUCT: Miele Classic C1 Junior Powerline Vacuum Cleaner, 4.5 Litre, 800 W

REVIEW: A very handy sized container which has proper hinges instead of bending plastic and rubber seals so that it will keep the damp from your ingredients. It is freezer, microwave and dishwasher safe. There is really nothing to fault with this container. I will be buying more.
PRODUCT: Sistema Klip It Mini Bakery Storage Container, Clear/White, 645 ml

REVIEW:
Overall this is a good product. The chain is quite thick but relatively light. It is protected (and your paint is protected from the chain) by a thick fabric. The five digit combination is easy to set to your own numbers and clicks easily into place. There is enough space between the dials to make setting the number easy. The chain is just long enough to go through your bike and frame and still attach to a close pole or railing.
The only downside I should that the plastic of the lock part itself is very sharp, so careful placement on your bike is required so that this doesn?t damage your paint.
PRODUCT: Provelo Combination Lock - Bike Lock with 5-Digit Combination and a Sturdy Chain

REVIEW_TITLE: Everyone who has seen it loves it.
REVIEW:
It is quite a simple idea - just photos of dogs catching treats (with a one page introduction and a few pages showing the names of the dogs) but everyone who has looked at this book loves it.
It isn?t particularly long, and you can leaf through it in a few minutes, but it is still good nonetheless. Certainly worth flipping through every now and again when you have a few minutes or need cheering up.
PRODUCT: Treat!: DOGS CATCHING TREATS: THE FUNNIEST DOG BOOK OF THE YEAR

REVIEW_TITLE: A great headset for the PS4 or PC gamer.
REVIEW: The clear instructions meant that this headset was easy to set up on my PS4. Build quality is very good, with strong feeling hinges and springy bits. Design is also very good - they are comfortable and everything is well laid out with controls easy to find and the microphone folding away well when not in use. Prolonged use didn?t not lead to pressure sores or over heating of my ears. Audio quality is excellent - deep bass and crisp highs, with little leakage so you can play at volume without annoying others in the room. When you select the superhuman mode it really doesn?t highlight significant sounds such as footsteps or reloading - a bit of an unfair advantage some would say. I found the connection reliable and stable, and the battery life to be long enough for a full day of gaming. It also works with my gaming PC running Windows 10 which is a very nice bonus.
PRODUCT: Turtle Beach Stealth 600 Wireless Surround Sound Gaming Headset for PS4 and PS4 Pro

REVIEW_TITLE: A nice watch with easy to read hands and a good range of adjustment
REVIEW: This is a very nice watch with a great colour scheme - nice matt grey with a striking pink accent and hands. It is quite light, the strap is flexible and it has a large enough range of adjustment to cover every wrist. The hands are easy to read in any light. Recommended.
PRODUCT: Ice-Watch duo Women's Analogue Quartz Watch with Rubber Strap - 001553

REVIEW_TITLE: A good looking and effective set
REVIEW:
This is a very stylish compact soap dispenser and steel soap bar set which should look good in any kitchen, backed up by the quality of Joseph Joseph.
The soap dispenser fills easily by removing the pump and takes a whole bottle of your favourite hand wash (I like strawberry laces). Pressing the pump gives a suitable measure of soap, and any drips are caught on the plastic tray beneath. I don?t know how the steel bar removes the smells of garlic and onions but it does. The whole thing Is very neat and effective.
You do need to look after the stainless steel, as residue from the soap can stain it, but otherwise this is a nice looking set which should last for years and save buying a whole new hand wash pump every time you refill.
PRODUCT: Joseph Joseph Surface Stainless-Steel Soap Pump and Bar - Silver

REVIEW_TITLE: A nice looking and potentially long lasting shower curtain
REVIEW: The pattern on my curtain doesn?t match the picture, although the colours are the same. The curtain is made from a woven fabric rather than a plastic sheet, so the curtain looks a lot better and hangs a lot better than other plastic sheet shower curtains. It is also machine washable so should last a lot longer than the plastic sheet curtains. Attachment is via buttonhole type holes in the top, and I was a bit disappointed to see that there are no rings included to fix this to the pole.
PRODUCT: InterDesign Moroccan Fabric Shower Curtain - 183 x 183 cm, Gray Multi

REVIEW_TITLE: Looks nice but a bit flimsy and the drawers are a bit small
REVIEW:
This advent calendar is a good replacement for the cheap cardboard ones we usually get for the kids. It looks pretty both when it is lit and when it is unlit. The scene is suitably festive yet not too gaudy and makes a nice centrepiece for the season.
The down sides are that it is made of very thin laser cut plywood. It certainly isn?t very durable. The drawers are on the small side, so if you are expecting to have a treat for every member of the family then you will need to find some very small treats.
Overall though this is a nice advent calendar which looks good and does the job, even though it is a bit flimsy and the drawers are on the small side.
PRODUCT: WeRChristmas Pre-Lit Wooden Church Scene Advent Calendar Christmas Decoration, 29 cm - Multi-Colour

REVIEW_TITLE: A nice set but average results
REVIEW: This product comes in a very attractive, but somewhat oversized gift box. Several members of my family have tried this set for a couple of weeks, following the instructions to the letter, and each one of them has reported that the results were average. Skin did feel cleaned and soft, but no more so than when they used their regular products. So overall it is a nice set, but the results were average.
PRODUCT: Gatineau Melatogenine Cleansing

REVIEW:
There is very little to fault this set. It comes with two masks and two sets of ear plugs in a carrying case. The mask is made of silk which is very soft and comfortable and effectively covers my eyes and blocks out light. The ear plugs are of a memory foam type and do a good job of blocking out sound.
All in all this is a good set.
PRODUCT: Sleep Mask,Eye Mask,Gratein Ultra Soft Skin-Friendly Pure Natural Silk Fabric and Natural Cotton Filled Sleeping Eye Mask with Adjustable Strap and Ear Plug for Men ,Women and Kids

REVIEW_TITLE: Soft skin and beard, nice smell of cedar wood.
REVIEW:
My daughter I saw always on a time me to not use soap to wash my face, and I have a beard so this seemed like a good product to use for the job.
The dispenser gives me enough for washing my face and beard with one pump, and the product feels rich and has a nice cedar wood smell. It produces a decent amount of foam, but not too much, and doesn?t sting if you get it in your eyes. After use my skin feels clean and soft, as does my beard. If I am going to shave then the bristles are softer and shaving causes less irritation. I haven?t tried it on my hair as it seems to be a bit expensive to use as shampoo.
I now use this every two or three days, as washing every day causes my beard to go a bit flyaway.
PRODUCT: L'Oreal Men Expert Barber Club 3-in-1 Beard, Hair & Face Wash, 200ml

REVIEW_TITLE: An excellent coffee table book about books
REVIEW: From the Dead Sea Scrolls to Harry Potter this book covers a good selection of some of the most significant books written so far. It tells the story of writing and creating the books with lots of great illustrations and photos. If you are interested in books, want to get your children into books, or just like coffee table books which you can dip on and out of then this is an excellent book.
PRODUCT: Books That Changed History: From the Art of War to Anne Frank's Diary (Dk)

REVIEW_TITLE: An incredibly useful thing to have around
REVIEW: Sugru is a very versatile handy thing to have around any house. You open up one of the little packs and mound it into whatever shape you require and after a number of hours it sets into a firm rubber. I have used it to repair broken plastic and rubber handles, to improve or fix strain relief bit so on cables, add non slip things to slippy surfaces, make hooks to hold cables, and many other things. There are literally hundreds of uses for this around the house, garage and car. I always keep some in the fridge (it has an expiry date and apparently lasts for longer if you keep it cold.)
PRODUCT: Sugru Mouldable Glue - Original Formula - Black, White & Grey 8-Pack

REVIEW: We use this as a doorstop, but it is very well made and comfortable in the hands with a rubber base to protect the floor.
PRODUCT: York Fitness 2kg-20kg Vinyl Kettlebells

REVIEW: The led is quite hard to see, but otherwise this is a good charger which works well with my Galaxy S8+ through a case.
PRODUCT: Wireless Charger, JETech Ultra-Slim Wireless Charging Pad For Apple iPhone 8/8 Plus, iPhone X, Galaxy Note 8, Samsung S8/S7/S6, Nexus 4/5/6/7, and More Qi-Enabled Device

REVIEW: The case fits the phone snugly and the cover snaps closed firmly to protect the screen from drops without adding too much thickness. The cover also holds open with the magnetic catch. Ports are easily accessible with the cover open or closed, and the recess actually makes finding the fingerprint scanner easier. The feel is a lot less slippy than the original phone. Overall I'm very happy with this case.
PRODUCT: OtterBox Strada Series for Samsung Galaxy S8+ - Onyx Black

REVIEW_TITLE: A good quality high performance cable.
REVIEW: This is a cable which feels durable and comes with an included velcro type cable tidy. You will see from the photos (the Bqeel has the cable tidy visible on the right) that performance is equal to the stock Samsung cable and allows for my Galaxy S8+ to fast charge. Recommended.
PRODUCT: Bqeel USB Type C Cable, USB-C to USB 3.0 Cable with Fast Charging and Data Transmission for MACBOOK,Lenovo YOGA900,HUAWEI Matebook HC-W09 and more USB-C and USB 3.0 Devices 1M-Black

REVIEW: These bulbs are very compact but produce a good amount of crisp white light. They do get a little warm around the base, but no more so than other brands of led bulb. Recommended.
PRODUCT: E14 SES LED BULB Kakanuo 4W Equivalent 35W Cooker Hood Cool White 6000K AC220-240V 360lumens Non-Dimmable Ceramics Energy Saving 51PCS 2835SMD (Pack of 2)

REVIEW_TITLE: A good set of ear defenders
REVIEW: A very comfortable and reasonably lightweight set of ear defenders which do a very good job of filtering out nose whilst still allowing a reasonable amount of voice through so you can hear someone taking loudly.
PRODUCT: 3M Peltor H520A-472-GB Optime II Earmuffs, 31 dB, Headband, Neon Green

REVIEW_TITLE: Essential for any electrician?s tool kit.
REVIEW:
On the face of it this is a strip of slightly bendy metal with a bit of padding. However the whole is so much more than the sum of the parts.
I bought this after watching a couple of teardown channels on YouTube as I like fixing my own stuff when I can. Previously I used a screwdriver, kitchen knife or anything else I could find lying around. This often caused damage to the casing being opened. With my new spudger I can open almost any plastic casing more easily and without causing anywhere near the damage I caused before. It bends where it needs to and is stiff where appropriate. The soft parts prevent it digging into your hands and there?s are different angles for various casings.
It comes attached to a card which shows how to open various common Apple products, but I would suggest having a search to find out the best techniques.
PRODUCT: iSesamo Spudger Repair Opening Pry Tool for Apple iPod, iPhone and iPad

REVIEW_TITLE: Adds ambience but could be brighter
REVIEW: This set of lights do add a bit of ambience to any TV. They stick well and are long enough to fit around the back of my 49 inch TV. The remote works well even with the sensor behind the telly, and allows a good selection of colours. If the lights were a bit brighter then the set would get five stars.
PRODUCT: LED TV backlight,2M USB Bias Lighting with 16 colors and 4 dynamic mode for 40 To 60 Inch HDTV,PC Monitor,led light strip.(4pcs x 50cm led strips)

REVIEW:
This is a very light Speyside malt which can be drunk on its own or with a drop of water or an ice cube. Notes of vanilla and honey but without any peat smoke flavour, as is common with Speyside malts. It is very mellow to drink, with hardly any burn in the throat, so mellow in fact that my wife who isn?t a whiskey drinker has enjoyed a couple of drams of this.
Presentation wise I like the packaging and the bottle will be recycled into a lamp, although it is a little bit unruly and I definitely suggest a two handed pour.
PRODUCT: Glenrothes Vintage Reserve Single Malt Scotch Whisky 70cl Bottle

REVIEW_TITLE: A bit on the large size but effective
REVIEW:
We got a medium for our pug who doesn't like to be left alone. The description said suitable for Dachshund, but I think we would have been better with a small. It does fit but is quite large on her and is a fiddle to get on.
It does work. She seems a bit more settled around the house and barks less at the neighbors. It's hard to really judge buy in the short term we are happy with the results.
PRODUCT: Karma Wrap Anxiety Coat, Medium

REVIEW:
I played Simon for years when I was a kid so looked forward to this update. I was a bit disappointed.
Firstly it doesn?t come with batteries, so if you are buying this for Christmas then you will need 4 aaa batteries to prevent disappointment. Secondly it doesn?t fit my head. I don?t have that big a head, size 60 in centimetres, but the band will not go large enough and the width of the unit is narrow and after about ten seconds I have to remove it. This made it unplayable for me.
For those of you with narrower heads the game is actually good. It takes a bit of practice to get the technique as the sensors can be quite unforgiving, but there are a few new moves which add to the Simon experience.
So the bottom line from me is that if your head isn?t large then you may well enjoy playing this game.
PRODUCT: Hasbro Gaming Simon Optix Game

REVIEW_TITLE: A natural looking tan which will last a few days
REVIEW:
This lotion comes out the bottle dark brown, the colour of marmite. It goes on well, but use a tanning mitt as it will stain your hands and is a bit difficult to remove. The smell is not overly unpleasant and quickly fades. It leaves a very natural looking tan which will last you for a few days.
Overall we like this product and recommend it.
PRODUCT: B.Tan Gradual Tan Lotion, 200 ml

REVIEW: This nail varnish is easy to apply and quite thick - one coat will do the job in most cases. It looks very glamorous, with a good sparkle and a colour to match the popular mobile phone brand. It lasted a couple of days of quite heavy hand use before the tips began to show wear and tear. It is quite pricey so maybe save it for special occasions, but overall it is a nice polish.
PRODUCT: Nails Inc Easy Chrome Nail Polish, Hell for Metal

REVIEW_TITLE: A good guide for the traveller
REVIEW:
Much if not all of the information in this book I should available off of the internet and is therefore free and has an expiry date. That said there is still something good about having a guide book to flip through to find attractions and places to eat and so on.
This book contains a lot of information for the prospective traveller clearly sorted into geographical and interest groups such as nightlife, events or accommodation. Each section has a summary, and the geographical ones have a map to complement the big pull out map contained in the book. Each place has a price guide, opening times, address and a few bits of information about what to expect. It is all very clear and easy to understand, and logically laid out.
The pull out map could have been made of higher quality paper - I doubt it would even last a day - and the information is time limited, so expect to buy a current version every few years. But otherwise this is a very useful and informative guide for the traveller to get the best out of a visit to the capital.
PRODUCT: Time Out London City Guide: Travel Guide with pull-out map (Time Out City Guides)

REVIEW:
I have been doing DIY for 20 plus years without one of these, and now that I have it I wondered how I managed without!
This square is very well made and easy to use. The markings are clear and easy to read, and the material it is made from is very sturdy.
A slight moan is that the distances are all in inches, but it is degrees which is important here and they are universal.
PRODUCT: Stanley 46-071 Premium Quick Square Layout Tool, 7"

REVIEW: This grinds pot is low enough to sit under the basket of your espresso machine when not in use. It is made of good quality materials and performs exactly as advertised. The rubberised bar prevents damage to the basket whilst the non-stick interior means that it is easy to clean. I would have liked the bar to be removable for deep cleaning, but otherwise this is just the job.
PRODUCT: Dreamfarm Grindenstein Steel Wool (Silver)

REVIEW: This product does exactly what it promises. The display is clear and it seems to be accurate and responsive.
PRODUCT: ThermoPro TP55 Digital Thermo-hygrometer with Larger Backlit Display, Monitor Temperature and Humidity for Comfort of Home and Office, Min/Max Records, Batteries Included, 5 Years Warranty

REVIEW_TITLE: Good sound quality for the size. Fast and reliable pairing.
REVIEW:
Considering the size of this speaker, about the size of an apple, the sound quality is good. Very good high and mid range, with an acceptable bass which can be improved a little depending which surface you place the speaker on. It is loud enough to fill a bedroom or for background in an office, but would struggle outdoors.
The instructions are in picture format, but reasonably easy to understand. the device is easy to use, with voice prompts and flashing LEDs. A play / pause / answer phone button is on the front of the speaker along with volume up and down.The microphone works well for hands free calling. At five hours the battery life is almost good enough to last a whole day. It pairs very quickly and reliably with my Samsung phone.
I now have this permanently on my desk as the sound quality is head and shoulders above that from the speaker on my phone. If it was water or splash proof then it would get five stars, but for what I am using it then it does the job very well.
PRODUCT: Jam Audio Reload - Portable Bluetooth Speaker, Ultra-Lightweight, 5hr Play Time Battery Life, Aux-In, Mic Speakerphone, Micro USB Rechargeable, Wireless Connect iPhone, iPad, Samsung + More - Blue

REVIEW: We use these tablets on our whites at a standard 40 degree wash. Cleaning power is good, but some stubborn stains such as grass or dried in food will need pre-treatment with a stain removing stick. The Febreeze smell is subtle and gets swamped by the fabric softener. Otherwise these are a good performing general washing tablet for all laundry.
PRODUCT: Ariel 3-in-1 With Febreze Washing Capsules 114 Washes - Pack of 3

REVIEW_TITLE: Good stain removal with less fade than standard bio
REVIEW: I have been washing my coloured work clothes with these tablets at 40 degrees for a year or so and have definitely noticed that the colour remains for longer than with standard bio tablets. Stain removal is generally good on standard coloured cotton cycle, although for some oily food stains I have had to pre-treat with a stain remover bar. Recommended.

REVIEW_TITLE: Good signal but annoying buzz from inside the unit when I use my subwoofer
REVIEW: This aerial does let me watch digital TV 15 miles exactly from the transmitter, and works through a stone wall. However inside is not fixed very well, so every time my subwoofer puts out a bassy note the aerial buzzes quite loudly. I have tried damping with rubber, but the noise is there all the time. If I move the aerial well away from the telly it stops, but then I have cable trailing across the room.
PRODUCT: One For All Amplified Indoor Aerial - Black - 46 dB Gain - Ready to recieve Freeview - Multi position digital Antenna - SV9435

REVIEW_TITLE: Another great value product from Amazon Basics
REVIEW:
This is another high quality low price item from the Amazon Basics range. A set of three suitcases which should be large enough for most family holidays.
Each case has the same extending handle, durable wheels and handy pockets and pouches in the liner. The opening is via zips which are again of a good quality. There is a further zip to give you a couple more inches of space should you come home with more than you left. The plastic material feels durable yet is quite light considering the size of these cases. And they all stack into each other for storage. The handles are a good length and the wheels allow for pulling across a smooth surface - either upright on all four or tilted on two. There are also carrying handles on the top and side and feet opposite to allow the cases to sit upright in different orientation.
My only slight reservation is that the feet seem a bit exposed, and I am not totally convinced that they would stand up to repeated airline baggage stresses. Time will tell and I will update if required.
PRODUCT: AmazonBasics Hardside Spinner Luggage - 3 Piece Set (22", 27", 31"/56 cm, 69 cm, 79 cm), Black

REVIEW_TITLE: Hard wearing non-stick wok which works well on induction hobs
REVIEW: This wok is a little bit smaller than my usual wok, but it still has room enough for a three or four person stir-fry. It heats up very well on my induction hob, and the non-stick means that it is a breeze to use and even more of a breeze to clean. Nothing sticks to it, even sticky sauce can be wiped off after use. The handles are riveted firmly and the coating is incredibly hard wearing - we have had a frying pan covered in the same ceramic non stick for a few years now and it is still as good as new.
PRODUCT: GreenPan Minneapolis Ceramic Non-Stick Open Wok, Stainless Steel, 30 cm

REVIEW: Fits in all of our car seats and effectively protects the upholstery from wet and muddy dogs. The dogs don't mind sitting on it and certainly prefer it to being in the boot. The only negative side is that the webbing is fairly cheap and is starting to slightly fray around the edges, but otherwise this is a very good product for the price.
PRODUCT: Amzdeal Dog Car Seat Covers Back- Waterproof & Scratchproof & Nonslip Pet Car Seat Protector Oxford Fabric Seat Covers for Trucks and SUVs - Coffee

REVIEW: The bits are hard to get out of the in-handle holder but otherwise this is a very good general purpose screwdriver to have in the kitchen drawer or tool belt. The shaft is removable to make it into a bit of a stubby screwdriver for those hard to reach places.
PRODUCT: Stanley FMHT0-62690 Bit-Screwdriver with 12 Bits, Black/Yellow, Set of 13 Piece

REVIEW_TITLE: Good sound quality, exceptional useability and flexibility
REVIEW: Love it. I now have two of these and one Echo Dot spread around the house. The whole family now use them for music, controlling our Phillips Hue lights, calendar, trivia, converting measurements, timers, schedules, reminders, news... The list goes on and on. Sound quality is good too.
PRODUCT: Amazon Echo, Black (previous generation)

REVIEW: A genuine pack of coils which produce a good amount of vapour with no after taste. Each one lasts me a couple of weeks of fairly decent use.
PRODUCT: Innokin 0.5 Ohm iSub Coil (Pack of 5)

REVIEW_TITLE: Excellent bun sized pan suitable for occasional hikers too
REVIEW: This pan is quite a bit smaller than I expected but as it turns out perfect for several reasons. Firstly it is ideal for cooking one egg, or making a bun sized filler like a burger or similar. Secondly because it is small, durable and very easy to clean it is going in my walking kit to pair up with my gas stove for my outdoor cooking. It heats up evenly and is durable and very easy to clean as well as being not too heavy.
PRODUCT: GreenPan 12.5 cm Ceramic Non Stick Round Open Fry Pan with Silicone Sleeve

REVIEW_TITLE: Good for delicate fabrics and delicate skin
REVIEW: These tablets do a good job of cleaning and are suited for those with sensitive skin as the amount of harsh chemicals is limited. I found that stubborn stains needed a warmer than 30 degree wash, and the most stubborn grease on cotton stains needed pre-treatment with a stain stick. We recommend these for delicate fabrics as well as delicate skin.

A very concise guide to building regulations in England and Wales. Well laid out with clear explanations and illustrations and a thorough contents and index. If the regulation isn't in here then the book normally gives a clear indication of where to go to find it.
PRODUCT: The Building Regulations: Explained and Illustrated

REVIEW: A really good lightweight (ish) cook set which fits well on to my gas stove. Durable and easy to keep clean. The mugs are just the right size and insulated to keep your drink warm when outdoors.
PRODUCT: Stanley Stainless Steel Flask Adventure Camp Cook Set - Green/ Silver, 0.71 Litre

REVIEW: A good strong stainless buckle for paracord projects. Very well machined these will hold a huge amount of weight. Took a week or so to arrive from China but worth the wait.
PRODUCT: HeroNeo� Adjustable Stainless Steel Bracelet Buckle Shackles for Outdoor Camping Paracord (Silver, 5pcs)

REVIEW_TITLE: A great set of fids for working with paracord
REVIEW: These do the job. Cut and melt the ends of the paracord and it will screw right in and hold very firmly. The metal is very thick and allows you to work the cord through awkward materials such as leather (make holes first).
PRODUCT: 550 Paracord Fids Lacing Stitching Weaving Needles, Stainless Steel, 2 Pack

REVIEW: We love this fire pit. The metal is thick enough so that the pit keeps its shape well, and once it heats up it stays hot for a good amount of time. The pit is large enough in diameter and height to accommodate a decent fire. It looks really good when the fire is burning. The handles are very sturdy when you need to carry it around, and the supplied rod for removing the cover is likewise very strong and durable. We are very happy with this.
PRODUCT: AmazonBasics Steel Lattice Fire Pit 60 cm (23.5 Inches)

REVIEW: Very good quality and very long cable. Charges iPhone and iPad at the same speed as the stock cables. The bright woven finish is durable and makes the cable easy to find.
PRODUCT: iPhone Cable 3m / 9.8ft JSCA Nylon Braided Lightning Cable/ iPhone Charger Cable for iPhone 6 / 6s / 6 plus / 6s plus / 5 / 5s / 5c / SE / 7 / 7 plus - 3 m (9.8ft) - RED

REVIEW: These slats were perfect for repairing a broken bed. They are a little bit thicker than the ones already on the (budget) bed but fit perfectly.
PRODUCT: SPRUNG BED SLATS 52MM X 8MM X 915MM - PACK OF 5

REVIEW_TITLE: Produces a good amount of heat
REVIEW: Mine arrived missing the feet. As it was too difficult to return due to my location I made some out of stuff I had lying around the shed. In use the rail produces a good amount of heat and dries the towels effectively.
PRODUCT: Status Portable Aluminium Heated Towel Rail with 6 Heated Bars, Silver, 100 W

REVIEW: A good bright light and lasts for a good few hours on the lower setting. The plastic is thick and the fasteners hold everything at the required angle.
PRODUCT: [Pack of 2]Solar Spotlight,Holan Powerful Solar Powered Security Spotlight Landscape Light,IP65 Waterproof,Auto on /off,180 �angle Adjustable, 2 in 1 Wall Light/In-ground Light for Outdoor Garden Backyard Pond Lawn Driveway Pathway

REVIEW_TITLE: Keeps my beer cold and fizzy at outdoor events.
REVIEW: I'm a big fan of Stanley products. This one does the job well and keeps my beer cold and fizzy at barbecues and outdoor events. The only thing that does annoy me a bit is that the lid stays at about fourty five degrees when open so does get in your face a bit when you are drinking. But otherwise this is a great product and certainly a talking point.
PRODUCT: Stanley Classic Vacuum Insulated Stein 24 oz, Hammertone Green

REVIEW_TITLE: A very good restorer for my second hand sofa
REVIEW:
Spent a few hours massaging this into a leather sofa bed which I had bought second hand and had spent a few years in a conservatory so was very dry and starting to crack. The transformation was very pleasing. The leather is a lot softer and more supple, and there is a subtle smell of vanilla when sitting in the sofa. There was a very slight tacky feel to the cushions for a day or two but this soon disappeared after a bit of use.
Love the product.
PRODUCT: Natural Chambers Leather Balsam Conditioner 200ml (Vanilla Notes)

REVIEW: Amazing gentle perfume which fills the room with a good throw!
PRODUCT: Honey Lavender Gelato Tarts Wax Melt

REVIEW: Nice style bottle, with a prism effect and golden lid. Inside is a wand in the lip gloss. The gloss itself is very well pigmented but the gloss is actually quite thick? I found it a little drying but long lasting! The gloss didn't slide off when I drank my coffee probably due to the thickness of the gloss which I guess is pretty good as its lasted through lunch. I found it to be quite different from my other glosses but not in a bad way, just a little different. I enjoyed the colour and would recommend and happy to purchase in a different shade.
PRODUCT: Max Factor Colour Elixir Honey Lacquer Lip Gloss, 3.8 ml, Indulgent Coral

REVIEW_TITLE: Fabulous pans, well built, good quality and a non stick that works like it says it should!
REVIEW: Wow.....this is an amazing set of pans. They look gorgeous with their copper colour. There is a small, mediium and large which will suit almost anyone! They cook lovely and I had no problems with them at, I am using on a gas hob and there is no marks or residue on the underside of the pan after use. Wash up lovely, I used a little fairy liquid and warm water and they cleaned up instantly. The non stick base is super good and I just can't recommend these enough!!! I will be adding to this set!! They are so attractive to look at too that they look very classy on the hob!
PRODUCT: Prestige Prism 14cm, 16cm and 18cm saucepan set, Aluminium, Copper, 3 piece set

REVIEW: These are so pretty, so very pretty and beautiful when a tea light is lit in them.....they give off a wondrous sparkly glow of metallics pinks and purple hues.....the fairies almost seem to dance when they are lit! I recommend these as a gift or just a treat to yourself with any tea light.....they will light up your room with a little magical sparkle.....
PRODUCT: Fairy Moon Set of 2 tea lights / Votive Holders

REVIEW: My son loves this razor and says its one of the best you can get out there....this set is a lovely gift of a new razor with 2 blades along with the set. As for the packaging well its not really relevant to the product but looks snazzy if you are into Marvel! We have the set for the razor and the blades which are hard to beat in terms of quality!
PRODUCT: Gillette Mach3 Turbo Razor Gift Set Justice League Limited Edition + 2 Blade Refills + Exclusive Virtual Reality Headset

REVIEW: Much loved fragrance of body wash and body spray by my teenage son! This is a fab gift box set, will be ideal for Christmas, Birthday or just a treat. Held in a cardboard box, containing, body wash, deodorant, body spray and of course the much sought after man washer! Great quality product and would be excellent for any guy who wants to smell fresh and thoroughly groomed!
PRODUCT: Lynx Excite Manwasher Gift Set

REVIEW: Nice thick tube of mascara. I would recommend as I have trouble with my lashes sticking together with some mascaras but this wand separated them lovely and gave a lovely finish! I have tried many mascaras and of different ranges and price tags but this is one I will come back to....there are not many I can say that about!
PRODUCT: Barry M Cosmetics Waterproof Mascara, That's How i Roll

REVIEW: Very simple and comfortable set of headphones, as long as the bluetooth connection can stay connected (dropped out several times for us) then these are just excellent! I listen to alot of audio books and these were just brilliant for the job, I was on the treadmill with these in and it was pretty good sound quality and the the contrast was lovely for my audio books.
PRODUCT: Jam Transit - Bluetooth In-Ear Headphones, Sport / Fitness Wireless Earbuds, 7hrs Play Time Battery Life, Speakerphone, Secures on Ears / Around Neck, Rechargeable, Sweat Resistant Earphones - Black

REVIEW: What a lovely presentation this is....little gift boxes tied together, makes a wonderful gift for someones birthday/christmas! Inside the boxes are the products displayed the fragrance is a lovely soft sweet and gentle flora scent. Very lovely.
PRODUCT: Baylis & Harding Stacking Gift Boxes, Boudoire Collection, Moonlight Peony

REVIEW: This is a very straight forward easy to use product. It is a lovely cooling moisturising gel for the eyes, simple to apply and sinks into skin beautifully leaving a smooth and more importantly refreshed feel around the eyes. Ideal for daily use of even if your eyes just feel tired, there is a fresh type of smell from this product, although it is fragrance free....its uplifting and refreshing and would recommend to anyone!
PRODUCT: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Eye-awakening Gelcream

REVIEW: My experience of TIGI products is that they are truly excellent and I have used them many times since having hair highlighted. This pack is gorgeous, looks nice and the products are excellent. The conditioning treatment has left my highlighted locks smooth and light and my hairs feels "gentle" and the fragrance is soft and comforting. Will make a lovely christmas gift for someone or just a super treat for yourself!
PRODUCT: TIGI Catwalk Backstage Beauty Gift Set

REVIEW: Lovely sturdy and well built headphones which feel really comfy over my ears and round my head, the mouthpiece doesn't get in the way, which I have found with other sets, its all very comfortable. Connectively to unit is excellent and the charge is very good, they lasted for an afternoon play for us. Sound quality is really fab making these, in my opinion, one of best sets out there in this price range, although I have tried higher end but frankly with these there is no need to spend even more as these feel good, and feel high end. The mic is good as friends have told me that I sound crystal clear their end and they sound amazing my end. All in all these are truly very good quality and highly recommended headphones.
PRODUCT: Razer Thresher 7.1 Playstation 4 (PS4) Wireless Gaming Headset, 7.1 Surround Sound with Retractable Microphone

REVIEW: A lovely packaged boxed watch. Hard plastic box containing watch in the centre, easy remove. Well built and made to last the rough and tumbles! Easy to set up just pull out side button and set and push back in to go! Very smart and a lovely bright Sea blue colour which really pleased the little person who received it to try. Would be suitable for boys and girls. The white fluorescent dials give this a lovely fresh and fun look. Much loved, much well received and recommended!
PRODUCT: Ice-Watch aqua Kids' Analogue Quartz Watch - 001457

REVIEW: Sweet scented gentle fragrance with a hint of Lavender is very pretty and fills the room beautifully. The seller, Caths Direct, was swift to post and arrived well packaged and safely. Very pleased with product and the service. Would recommend.
PRODUCT: 6 x Yankee Candle Wax Tart Melts (Honey Lavender Gelato)

REVIEW: This is a lovely and very pretty watch! Comes in a gorgeous gift box and sits on a cushion within. A beautiful Navy Blue strap with navy blue fascia and golden dials/hands. There is diamante all around the dial and these really catch the light! So sparkling and pretty and just a joy The watch is a lovely fit on my wrist and is very smart and femine. Very easy to set up with the button on the side just pull out and set time, push back in. There is a screen protector over the face to remove before wearing and a pull to start the battery to life. I am extremely impressed with this watch and would recommend to any lady looking for a watch with a bit of bling....this has it all!
PRODUCT: Versus by Versace Women's Watch VSPCD2817

REVIEW_TITLE: Not exactly what you are expecting this to be
REVIEW: This is not some sort of Exercise Bike of any sorts. It is something that would deem most useful in a Physiotherapy Unit or available through the NHS. It is for those that are mainly either immobile, or recovering from surgery of sorts. It is a gentle mobility item which encourages leg movement which of course is essential for the elderly or infirm to prevent the likes of blood clots etc. I expect it is good for what it is intended.
PRODUCT: Reviber Mini Motorised Pedal Exerciser - fully assembled with 2 year guarantee

REVIEW: So this a nice lightweight battery powered hoover. In the box is the unit itself along with a long tube and several different attachment, easily put together and every slots into place with ease. Its fairly quick to charge for a 25 minute run. I found it very helpful to use to do my stairs, you can hoover alot of smaller places that a larger hoover can't reach. I think this is an excellent addition to the cleaning cupboard but it is no replacement for a large regular hoover in our home as we are a family of 5 with 2 cats and 3 dogs, so we have tested this unit to the full extent of its ability, But its definitely going to be useful as an extra hoover as it will cover areas hard to use a regular hoover in, but for the main carpeted areas I will still use my other hoover. However, if used for a small space with less occupants this may well be suitable enough for use in total and will be easier to handle than a full size hoover as its much lighter to hold, should this be for an elderly person or even someone with disabilities this would be more suitable in some circumstances and extremely useful.
PRODUCT: Hoover FD22BCPET Freedom Pets Lithium 2 in 1 Cordless Stick Vacuum Cleaner, 0.7 Litre, Black/Turquoise

REVIEW: Very well built and sturdy headphone. The noise cancelling bonus really makes a difference as it works extremely well. They are a comfortable fit over my ears and the head band is very comfortable too. Sound quality is excellent and microphone is very clear. Gamers could hear me very well from their end and I could hear them crystal clear from mine. The only downside to them we found was that the dip drop out of connection sometimes, the bluetooth works mostly but on occasion we found it really annoying that there was drop out. We were standing only a few feet from the machine when this happened, but we will persevere.
PRODUCT: Turtle Beach Stealth 700 Premium Wireless Surround Sound Gaming Headset for PS4 and PS4 Pro

REVIEW: Loads of fun and incredibly priced. Sturdy well made and work a wonder with a wax melt piece in the saucer and a fragrance tea light underneath. I love pink flamingos so this purchase is a no brainer for me, or indeed anyone whom loves them!
PRODUCT: Set Of 2 Ceramic Flamingo Shaped Aromatherapy Office Home Fragrance Oil Burner

REVIEW_TITLE: Not for me but they are the usual high quality standard expected from Yankee Candle
REVIEW: Lovely gift box containing some new fragrances....Cookie Swap. They are up to the usual standard that you would expect from Yankee, however, I found them to be very sickly in scent and have passed them over. I found them to be very "fake" in fragrance and I immediately got a headache.
PRODUCT: Yankee Candle Cookie Swap 6 Votive Gift Set, Cardboard, Multi-Colour, 5.1 x 16.9 x 13.8 cm

REVIEW_TITLE: Lovely quality in lovely presentation box
REVIEW: What a lovely tin...containing an assorted rainbow of colours through the colour spectrum. Pretty much any colour you could need is here. The chalk pastels themselves are lovely and sturdy and well made and very tactile to hold. Colours amazing and have been put to good use by my daughter who is in art college. She says they are amazing and easy to use, a new favourite.
PRODUCT: STABILO CarbOthello Metal Box of 12 colours - Chalk-pastel coloured pencil

REVIEW_TITLE: Well made and excellent quality toy
REVIEW: This is an excellent sized figure with plenty of flexibility in movement for play. He has 12 sayings which really adds to play time! He is robust and well made and will be an excellent toy for an imaginative mind or an excellent collectors item for anyone whom loves the franchise or superheroes!
PRODUCT: SPIDER-MAN B96931020 "Homecoming Eye FX" Electronic Toy

REVIEW: This is an excellent revision guide for anyone who is studying the new GCSE in this subject! It has 2 full papers in it with answers and gives clear conscise revision material. My son is in Year 10 and studying Computer Science as one of his favourites and this will be absolutely brilliant in helping him revise as he prefers to work on the subject to learn and remember rather than just reading, so these test papers will be brilliant. I would recommend this to anyone else studying the same.
PRODUCT: New GCSE Computer Science OCR Practice Papers - for the Grade 9-1 Course

REVIEW_TITLE: Nice and easy to use accurate tin openers.
REVIEW: What can I say, these are excellent can openers! Not too heavy so fairly lightweight and easy to grip the can, press down and turn handle and hey presto can open. Have struggled with some very lightweight small type openers in the past and found these to be much easier and better to use. Would recommend.
PRODUCT: Swing-A-Way Heavy-Duty Can Opener, 18 cm (7") - Black

REVIEW: Everything a man needs for a lovely groom in one bag.....convenient for everyday use, or travel or just somewhere neat and tidy to keep everything and the bag can be used after the products have gone. All items will be very useful to most guys and will make a lovely gift, whatever the occasion, but will boost the christmas stocking! As ever with such a brand as Nivea all items are of good quality and well made.
PRODUCT: Nivea Men Prepared Gift Pack

REVIEW: Extremely sturdy and well built headphones, look very classy. Very comfortable to wear, fit is perfect and the cancel out any sound outside the headset. Music was crisp and clear to hear and I particularly enjoyed them for listening to audio books, was pure class. Had a bit of trouble with bluetooth, kept loosing the signal to the music/book source (iPad in this instance), have kept persevering and hoping things will improve once am used to using them. Extremely good set of Headphones which I wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
PRODUCT: Bose QuietComfort 35 Wireless Headphones II - Black

REVIEW: Possibly the best wok I have ever used.......and there have been many....... Ideal size, I made a stir fry with noodles for 2 of us. The coating is superior quality and nothing stuck, even heat distribution, soft touch handle so very tactile and comfortable in hand, heavy but not too heavy so light enough to move around with ease. Everything cooked in no time at all and was hot wherever the food was in the pan. No burning and no mess.....we are large family so we didn't have room in the dishwasher to put this, although it does say its dishwasher proof, but I used a little drop of fairy liquid and it came out amazingly clean in seconds. Frankly its brilliant and I would recommend to all. One thing to remember is however that you mustn't use metal instruments in the pan.....only wooden or plastic or silicone plastic, so as not to scratch the non stick surface! I have a few items in the Oxo range and intend to purchase more.
PRODUCT: OXO "Softworks" Non-Stick Wok, Black, 28 cm

REVIEW_TITLE: This is a simple device, but wow what a difference it makes!
REVIEW: This is a really nifty piece of kit. Very easy to use, fill to the level with water and crack the eggs and put in the individual cups. Place in microwave and go....you will need to work out the best time for you as they suggest eggs to be room temperature (we took ours straight from fridge however) and of course all microwaves are different, no 2 are the same. We cooked 2 poached eggs in a 850watt microwave and it took 2 mins and 20 seconds for the perfect poached egg. But, all microwaves will be different so they suggest checking every 10 seconds after the initial 1min 50 secs which is the suggested initial cooking time. When you have worked out the best timing for you, you will not look back as this is the easiest way of having poached eggs that we have found! Also the poacher is very easy to wash up afterwards! Can go in dishwasher too.
PRODUCT: Sistema Microwave Poacher for up to 4 Eggs, Red/Clear, 28.7 x 20.5 x 8.4 cm

REVIEW: This is a nicely designed iron. I am a big fan of Phillips irons as have many different brands over the years but its Phillips that have lasted the longest for me. We are a family of 5 and a frequent guest so we have lots and lots of ironing here! I have been using a Phillips up to now and this is one to replace it. A good weight, not too heavy but heavy enough, holds a good amount of water (I only needed to fill up once through a session of 1 and half hours) and the iron temps are good. Ploughed through a load of mixed ironing, from shirts to jeans and it gave a very good performance. Recommended for a good quality iron at a mid price range.
PRODUCT: Philips PowerLife Steam Iron GC2998/86 with up to 170g Steam Boost

REVIEW: I agree with one of the other reviewers in that why must they have the label/instruction leaflet glued to the tray, though I was going to take the coating off trying to remove it and then had to gently clean residue away. Other than this, the tray is a very good heavy weight and quality item, of good size, I have used to make cookies, in 2 batches and there was no sticking and I was able to use fairy liquid to wash up beautifully and the tray came up lovely and clean with no staining. I will use again, and would recommend to anyone looking for a really good quality reliable cooking tray.
PRODUCT: OXO Good Grips Non-Stick Pro Oven Tray, Gold

REVIEW_TITLE: Nice much larger version of its little brother....
REVIEW: Had an older model of Nespresso and enjoyed very much. This is a much bigger version, so I have had to rearrange my worktops to fit it in, as kitchen is not huge, however it does look pretty smart! We found this to be very easy to use, a few buttons to press and that was all, we have been used to a smaller one though so unlike some other reviewers we found this very user friendly. We always heat the milk slightly in microwave and then add the coffee to it and its pretty yummy.. This machine excellent as you can have a larger cup of coffee now, this is exactly what we have been hoping for as it makes for a lovely any time of day superb cup of coffee. Now the only gripe I have is I am struggling to locate the new pods??? I will keep looking but they need to get these more readily available, maybe they will be soon.
PRODUCT: Nespresso Vertuo Plus, Black finish by Magimix

REVIEW: I read this book very quickly for me, the first in the series really set the scene and this book was a joy to behold that we were learning and discovering about the lives of one of the characters from the first book! I was disappointed that there was no applicator with this, either a little sponge powder puff pad or small brush however, it doesn't put me off as I used a small alternative face brush to apply and I found it be a lovely fresh and dewy look that the powder creates on my skin. Ivory rose suited my pale skin nicely and I would definitely go back for more of this, however, will last a while as a little definitely goes a long way and is a fab base for your makeup, its a great little pot!

REVIEW: So I have tested this item this morning on my 2 Yorkshire Terrier pups, miniatures. They have been used to having clips so these did not frighten them although we didn't find them to be too noisy anyway. This kit is very well presented, comes in a hard wearing plastic box which contains everything neatly tucked inside, not as easy to put it all back for storage but to be fair it can be done. We have used Wahl before and to be honest we have found them ok, but not brilliant. We used comb 3 and got dog into position. We found that the clipper worked reasonably well through their fur but its patchy, it takes alot of time and patience to get there with these. They do last along time and performance is not affected despite running for several minutes. I did in the end take the comb off the clippers and used without which is dicey unless you have had alot of practice....when I did this I found the clippers to be very good and gave a clean cut but I had to do this with great care so as not to catch dogs skin. I prefer the attachment combs as you can relax when using safe in the knowledge that you will not catch the dogs skin, however, I have to confess struggling with these to get the job done that way. I have worked in a groomers previously and was trained to use clippers with and without combs so these are satisfactory to me to be used with comb, but I would advise other users to be very cautious. Maybe these are not ideal for my dogs fur, could be that although its thin and silky which the box states these are ideally made for. I will persevere and try again! I would recommend them with caution but the set is top notch in terms of what is provided, lots of choice with combs, you have the cleaner lubricant for the clip and brushes to clean. Its a one box stop.
PRODUCT: Wahl Pro Series Lithium dog / pet clipper Kit

Its a stiff plastic pencil liner which gives the impression that it will twist up and that would make it just perfect, but no, alas you have to use a pencil sharpener on the plastic pencil which clearly not all pencil sharpeners like, so I have ended up with a messy looking half sharpened lip liner which is pretty much good for nothing now and am now on the search for a new one....different one of course. I think L'Oreal are totally on to a good product here, but they may need to spend a tiny bit more on the pencil and make it twistable instead then I will be back to buy more, but until then I am definitely on the fence with this one!

REVIEW_TITLE: Nice new scent from this quality candle company...
REVIEW: Nice quality candle! Deep orangey red candle wrapped in thick paper to protect until used. I placed on a candle plate, removed paper, the fragrance is incredible from the candle, its a really sherbetty zesty cranberry with a backdrop of the gingery tone as the under fragrance.. which is great for the Autumn/Winter time. The candle was easy to light and burnt lovely, taking the wax pool quite away across the candle itself. You should aim to burn these candles for 2-3 hours at a time this way you avoid the "tunnelling" of the candle when you have a small pool in the centre of the candle that doesn't expand across ....... this will shorten the life of your candle rendering it difficult to light later on. If you burn 2-3 hours then your candle has enough time to burn across which then makes the burn even and you get the most out of your candle. If you burn for longer then you risk the mishap of your candle by bulging the wax out of the initial candle shape. When burning this candle has a really good throw and can be smelt in other rooms around the house from it. Quality is second to none with this brand and I would recommend them and this candle in a heartbeat!

REVIEW: This is a large item so you will firstly need a good of storage space/area for it or a fair amount of space in a cupboard for it.
